sarvopamaṃtrairmaṃtrādhvā vyāptaḥ paramavidyayā | yathā śivo na tattveṣu gaṇyate tattvanāyakaḥ ||
maṃtrādhvani na gaṇyeta tathāsau maṃtranāyakaḥ | kalādhvano vyāpakatvaṃ vyāpyatvaṃ cetarādhvanām ||
na vetti tattvato yasya naivārhatyadhvaśodhanam | ṣaḍvidhasyādhvano rūpaṃ na yena viditaṃ bhavet ||
vyāpyavyāpakatā tena jñātumeva na śakyate | tasmādadhvasvarūpaṃ ca vyāpyavyāpakatāṃ tathā ||
yathāvadavagamyaiva kuryādadhvaviśodhanam | kuṃḍamaṃḍalaparyaṃtaṃ tatra kṛtvā yathā purā ||
dvihastamānaṃ kurvīta prācyāṃ kalaśamaṃḍalam | tataḥ snātaśśivācāryaḥ saśiṣyaḥ kṛtanaityakaḥ ||
praviśya maṃḍalaṃ śaṃbhoḥ pūjāṃ pūrvavadācaret | tatrāḍhakāvaraissiddhaṃ taṃdulaiḥ pāyasaṃ prabhoḥ ||
ardhaṃ nivedya homārthaṃ śeṣaṃ samupakalpayet | purataḥ kalpite vātha maṃḍale varṇimaṃḍite ||
sthāpayetpañcakalaśāndikṣu madhye ca deśikaḥ | teṣu brahmāṇi mūlārṇairbindunādasamanvitaiḥ ||
nama ādyairyakarāṃtaiḥ kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ | īśānaṃ madhyame kuṃbhe puruṣaṃ purataḥ sthite ||
aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe vāme vāmaṃ sadyaṃ ca paścime | rakṣāṃ vidhāya mudrā ca baddhvā kuṃbhābhimaṃtraṇam ||
kṛtvā śivānalairhomaṃ prārabhetyathā purā | yadardhaṃ pāyasaṃ pūrvaṃ homārthaṃ parikalpitam ||
hutvā śiṣyasya taccheṣaṃ bhoktuṃ samupakalpayet | tarpaṇāṃtaṃ ca maṃtrāṇāṃ kṛtvā karma yathā purā ||
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ teṣāṃ tataḥ kuryātpradīpanam | oṃkārādanu huṃkāraṃ tato mūlaṃ phaḍaṃtakam ||
svāhāṃtaṃ dīpane prāhuraṃgāni ca yathākramam | teṣāmāhutayastisro deyā dīpanakarmaṇi ||
maṃtrairekaikaśastaistu vicintyā dīptamūrtayaḥ | triguṇaṃ triguṇī kṛtya dvijakanyākṛtaṃ sitam ||
sūtraṃ sūtreṇa saṃmaṃtrya śikhāgre baṃdhayecchiśoḥ | caraṇāṃguṣṭhaparyaṃtamūrdhvakāyasya tiṣṭhataḥ ||
laṃbayitvā tu tatsūtraṃ suṣumṇāṃ tatra yojayet | śāṃtayā mudrayādāya mūlamaṃtreṇa maṃtravit ||
hutvāhutitrayaṃ tasyāssānnidhyamupakalpayet | hṛdi saṃtāḍya śiṣyasya puṣpakṣepeṇa pūrvavat ||
caitanyaṃ samupādāya dvādaśāṃte nivedya ca | sūtraṃ sūtreṇa saṃyojya saṃrakṣyāstreṇa varmaṇā ||
avaguṃṭhyātha tatsūtraṃ śiṣyadehaṃ viciṃtayet | mūlatrayamayaṃ pāśaṃ bhogabhogyatvalakṣaṇam ||
viṣayendriyadehādijanakaṃ tasya bhāvayet | vyomādibhūtarūpiṇyaḥ śāṃtyatītādayaḥ kalāḥ ||
sūtre svanāmabhiryojyaḥ pūjyaścaiva namoyutaiḥ | athavā bījabhūtaistatkṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ kramāt ||
tato malādestattvādau vyāptiṃ samalokayet | kalāvyāptiṃ malādau ca hutvā saṃdīpayetkalāḥ ||
śiṣyaṃ śirasi saṃtāḍya sūtraṃ dehe yathākramam | śāṃtyatītapade sūtraṃ lāñchayenmaṃtramuccaran ||
evaṃ kṛtvā nivṛttyantaṃ śāṃtyatītamanukramāt | hutvāhutitrayaṃ paścānmaṇḍale ca śivaṃ yajet ||
devasya dakṣiṇe śiṣyamupaveśyottarāmukham | sadarbhe maṇḍale dadyāddhomaśiṣṭaṃ caruṃ guruḥ ||
śiṣyastadguruṇā dattaṃ satkṛtya śivapūrvakam | bhuktvā paścāddvirācamya śivamantramudīrayet ||
apare maṇḍale dadyātpañcagavyaṃ tathā guruḥ | so 'pi tacchaktitaḥ pītvā dvirācamya śivaṃ smaret ||
tṛtīye maṇḍale śiṣyamupaveśya yathā purā | pradadyāddaṃtapavanaṃ yathāśāstroktalakṣaṇam ||
agreṇa tasya mṛdunā prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ | vācaṃ niyamya cāsīnaśśiṣyo daṃtānviśodhayet ||
prakṣālya daṃtapavanaṃ tyaktvācamya śivaṃ smaret | praviśeddeśikādiṣṭaḥ prāṃjaliḥ śivamaṇḍalam ||
tyaktaṃ taddantapavanaṃ dṛśyate guruṇā yadi | prāgudakpaścime vāgre śivamanyacchivetaram ||
aśastāśāmukhe tasmingurustaddoṣaśāṃtaye | śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vājuhuyānmūlamantrataḥ ||
tataḥ śiṣyaṃ samālabhya japitvā karṇayoḥ śivam | devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge taṃ śiṣyamadhivāsayet ||
ahatāstaraṇāstīrṇe sa darbhaśayane śuciḥ | maṃtrite 'ntaḥ śivaṃ dhyāyañśayīta prākchirā niśi ||
śikhāyāṃ baddhasūtrasya śikhayā tacchikhāṃ guruḥ | ābadhyāhatavastreṇa tamācchādya ca varmaṇā ||
rekhātrayaṃ ca parito bhasmanā tilasarṣapaiḥ | kṛtvāstrajaptaistadvāhye digīśānāṃ baliṃ haret ||
śiṣyo 'pi parato 'naśnankṛtvaivamadhivāsanam | prabudhyotthāya gurave svapnaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ nivedayet ||
upamanyuruvāca | tataḥ snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyācāryacoditaḥ | gacchedbaddhāṃjalirdhyāyañchivamaṇḍalapārśvataḥ ||
atha pūjāṃ vinā sarvaṃ kṛtvā pūrvadine yathā | netrabaṃdhanaparyaṃtaṃ darśayenmaṇḍalaṃ guruḥ ||
baddhanetreṇa śiṣyeṇa puṣpāvakiraṇe kṛte | yatrāpataṃti puṣṇāṇi tasya nāmā 'sya saṃdiśet ||
taṃ copanīya nirmālyamaṇḍale 'sminyathā purā | pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ juhuyācca śivānale ||
śiṣyeṇa yadi duḥsvapno dṛṣṭastaddoṣaśāṃtaye | śatamardhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā juhuyānmūlavidyayā ||
tataḥ sūtraṃ śikhābaddhaṃ laṃbayitvā yathā purā | ādhārapūjāprabhṛti yannivṛttikalāśrayam ||
vāgīśvarīpūjanāṃtaṃ kuryāddhomapurassaram | atha praṇamya vāgīśaṃ nivṛttervyāpikāṃ satīm ||
maṇḍale devamabhyarcya hutvā caivāhutitrayam | prāpayecca śiśoḥ prāptiṃ yugapatsarvayoniṣu ||
sūtradehe 'tha śiṣyasya tāḍanaprokṣaṇādikam | kṛtvātmānaṃ samādāya dvādaśāṃte nivedya ca ||
tato 'pyādāya mūlena mudrayā śāstradṛṣṭayā | yojayenmanasācāryo yugapatsarvayoniṣu ||
devānāṃ jātayaścāṣṭau tiraścāṃ pañca jātayaḥ | jātyaikayā ca mānuṣyā yonayaśca caturdaśa ||
tāsu sarvāsu yugapatpraveśāya śiśordhiyā | vāgīśānyāṃ yathānyāyaṃ śiṣyātmānaṃ niveśayet ||
garbhaniṣpattaye devaṃ saṃpūjya praṇipatya ca | hutvā caiva yathānyāyaṃ niṣpannaṃ tadanusmaret ||
niṣpannasyaivamutpattimanuvṛttiṃ ca karmaṇā | ārjavaṃ bhoganiṣpattiḥ kuryātprītiṃ parāṃ tathā ||
niṣkṛtyarthaṃ ca jātyāyurbhogasaṃskārasiddhaye | hutvāhutitrayaṃ devaṃ prārthayeddeśikottamaḥ ||
bhoktṛtvaviṣayāsaṃgamalaṃ tatkāyaśodhanam | kṛtvaivameva śiṣyasya chiṃdyātpāśatrayaṃ tataḥ ||
nikṛtyā pari baddhasya pāśasyātyaṃtabhedataḥ | kṛtvā śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ svacchaṃ manyeta kevalam ||
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ vahnau brahmāṇaṃ pūjayettataḥ | hutvāhutitrayaṃ tasmai śivājñāmanusaṃdiśet ||
pitāmaha tvayā nāsya yātuḥ śaivaṃ paraṃ padam | pratibandho vidhātavyaḥ śaivājñaiṣā garīyasī ||
ityādiśya tamabhyarcya visṛja ca vidhānataḥ | samabhyarcya mahādevaṃ juhuyādāhutitrayam ||
nivṛttyā śuddhamuddhṛtya śiṣyātmānaṃ yathā purā | niveśyātmani sūtre ca vāgīśaṃ pūjayettataḥ ||
hutvāhutitrayaṃ tasmai praṇamya ca visṛjya tām | kuryānnivṛttaḥ saṃdhānaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ kalayā saha ||
saṃdhāne yugapatpūjāṃ kṛtvā hutvāhutitrayam | śiṣyātmanaḥ pratiṣṭhāyāṃ praveśaṃ tvatha bhāvayet ||
tataḥ pratiṣṭhāmāvāhya kṛtvāśeṣaṃ puroditam | tadvyāptiṃ vyāpikāṃ tasya vāgīśānīṃ ca bhāvayet ||
pūrṇedumaṃḍalaprakhyāṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat | viṣṇave saṃviśedājñāṃ śivasya paramātmanaḥ ||
viṣṇorvisarjanādyaṃ ca kṛtvā śeṣaṃ ca vidyayā | pratiṣṭhāmanusaṃdhāya tasyāṃ cāpi yathā purā ||
kṛtvānucintya tadvyāptiṃ vāgīśāṃ ca yathākramam | dīptāgnau pūrṇahomāntaṃ kṛtvā śeṣaṃ ca pūrvavat ||
nīlarudramupasthāpya tasmai pūjādikaṃ tathā | kṛtvā karma śivājñāṃ ca dadyātpūrvoktavartmanā ||
tapastamapi codvāsya kṛtvā tasyātha śāṃtaye | vidyākalāṃ samādhāya tadvyāptiṃ cāvalokayet ||
svātmano vyāpikāṃ tadvadvāgīśīṃ ca yathā purā | bālārkasadṛśākārāṃ bhāsayaṃtīṃ diśo daśa ||
tataḥ śeṣaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā devaṃ maheśvaram | āvāhyārādhya hutvāsmai śivājñāṃ manasā diśet ||
maheśvaraṃ tathotsṛjya kṛtvānyāṃ ca kalāmimām | śāṃtyatītāṃ kalāṃ nītvā tadvyāptimavalokayet ||
svātmano vyāpikāṃ tadvadvāgīśāṃ ca viciṃtayet | nabhomaṃḍalasaṃkāśāṃ pūrṇāṃtaṃ cāpi pūrvavat ||
kṛtvā śeṣavidhānena samabhyarcya sadāśivam | tasmai samādiśedājñāṃ śaṃbhoramitakarmaṇaḥ ||
tatrāpi ca yathāpūrvaṃ śivaṃ śirasi pūrvavat | samabhyarcya ca vāgīśaṃ praṇamya ca visarjayet ||
tataśśivena samprokṣya śiṣyaṃ śirasi pūrvavat | vilayaṃ śāṃtyatītāyāḥ śaktitattve 'tha ciṃtayet ||
ṣaḍadhvanaḥ pare pāre sarvādhvavyāpinī parām | koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ śaivīṃ śaktiñca cintayet ||
tadagre śiṣyamānīya śuddhasphaṭikanirmalam | prakṣālya kartarīṃ paścācchivaśāstroktamārgataḥ ||
kuryāttasya śikhācchedaṃ saha sūtreṇa deśikaḥ | tatastāṃ gomaye nyasya śivāgnau juhuyācchikhām ||
vauṣaḍaṃtena mūlena punaḥ prakṣālya kartarīm | haste śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ taddehe vinivartayet ||
tataḥ snātaṃ samācāṃtaṃ kṛtasvastyayanaṃ śiśum | praveśya maṃḍalābhyāsaṃ praṇipatya ca daṃḍavat ||
pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ kriyāvaikalyaśuddhaye | vācakenaiva maṃtreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayam ||
upāṃśūccārayogena juhuyādāhutitrayam | punassaṃpūjya deveśaṃ mantravaikalyaśuddhaye ||
mānasoccārayogena juhuyādāhutitrayam | tatra śaṃbhuṃ samārādhya maṃḍalasthaṃ sahāṃbayā ||
hutvāhutitrayaṃ paścātprārthayetprāṃjalirguruḥ | bhagavaṃstvatprasādena śuddhirasya ṣaḍadhvanaḥ ||
kṛtā tasmātparaṃ dhāma gamayainaṃ tavāvyayam | iti vijñāpya devāya nāḍīsaṃdhānapūrvakam ||
pūrṇāṃtaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā tato bhūtāni śodhayet | sthirāsthire tataḥ śuddhyai śītoṣṇe ca tataḥ pade ||
dhyāyedvyāptyaikatākāre bhūtaśodhanakarmaṇi | bhūtānāṃ graṃthivicchedaṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā sahādhipaiḥ ||
bhūtāni sthitayogena yo japetparame śive | viśodhyāsya tanuṃ dagdhvā plāvayitvā sudhākaṇaiḥ ||
sthāpyātmānaṃ tataḥ kuryādviśuddhādhvamayaṃ vapuḥ | tatrādau śāntyatītāṃ tu vyāpikāṃ svādhvanaḥ kalām ||
śuddhāmeva śiśormūrdhni nyasecchāntimukhe tathā | vidyāṃ galādinābhyaṃtaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ tadadhaḥ kramāt ||
jānvaṃtaṃ tadadho nyasyennivṛttiṃ cānuciṃtayet | svabījaissūtramaṃtraṃ ca nyasyāṃ gaistaṃ śivātmakam ||
buddhvā taṃ hṛdayāṃbhoje devamāvāhya pūjayet | āśāsya nityasāṃnidhyaṃ śivasvātmyaṃ śiśau guruḥ ||
śivatejomayasyāsya śiśorāpādayedguṇān | aṇimādīnprasīdeti pradadyādāhutitrayam ||
tathaiva tu guṇāneva punarasyopapādayet | sarvajñātāṃ tathā tṛptiṃ bodhaṃ cādyantavarjitam ||
aluptaśaktiṃ svātantryamanaṃtāṃ śaktimeva ca | tato devamanujñāpya sadyādikalaśaistu tam ||
abhiṣiṃceta deveśaṃ dhyāyanhṛdi yathākramam | athopaveśya taṃ śiṣyaṃ śivamabhyarcya pūrvavat ||
labdhānujñaḥ śivācchaivīṃ vidyāmasmai samādiśet | oṃkārapūrvikāṃ tatra saṃpuṭāntu namo 'ṃtagām ||
śivaśaktiyutāñcaiva śaktividyāṃ ca tādṛśīm | ṛṣiṃ chandaśca devaṃ ca śivatāṃ śivayostathā ||
pūjāṃ sāvaraṇāṃ śambhorāsanāni ca sandiśet | punaḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ yanmayā samanuṣṭhitam ||
sukṛtaṃ kuru tatsarvamiti vijñāpayecchivam | sahaśiṣyo gururdevaṃ daṇḍavatkṣitimaṃḍale ||
praṇamyodvāsayettasmānmaṃḍalātpāvakādapi | tataḥ sadasikāḥ sarve pūjyāḥ pūjārhakāḥ kramāt ||
sevyā vittānusāreṇa sadasyāśca sahartvijaḥ | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ ||
upamanyuruvāca | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sādhakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ | saṃskāramantramāhātmyaṃ kathane sūcitaṃ mayā ||
saṃpūjya maṃḍale devaṃ sthāpya kumbhe ca pūrvavat | hutvā śiṣyamanuṣṇīṣaṃ prāpayedbhuvi maṃḍale ||
pūrvāṃtaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā hutvāhutiśataṃ tathā | saṃtarpya mūlamantreṇa kalaśairdeśikottamaḥ ||
sandīpya ca yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā pūrvoditaṃ kramāt | abhiṣicya yathāpūrvaṃ pradadyānmantramuttamam ||
tatra vidyopadeśāṃtaṃ kṛtvā vistaraśaḥ kramāt | puṣpāmbunā śiśoḥ pāṇau vidyāṃ śaivīṃ samarpayet ||
tavaihikāmuṣmikayoḥ sarvasiddhiphalapradaḥ | bhavatyeva mahāmantraḥ prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ ||
ityutvā devamabhyarcya labdhānujñaḥ śivādguruḥ | sādhanaṃ śivayogaṃ ca sādhakāya samādiśet ||
tacchrutvā gurusaṃdeśaṃ kramaśo maṃtrasādhakaḥ | purato viniyogasya mantrasādhanamācaret ||
sādhanaṃ mūlamantrasya puraścaraṇamucyate | purataścaraṇīyatvādviniyogākhyakarmaṇaḥ ||
nātyantaṃ karaṇīyantu mumukṣormantrasādhanam | kṛtantu tadihānyatra tāsyāpi śubhadaṃ bhavet ||
śubhe 'hani śubhe deśe kāle vā doṣavarjite | śukladantanakhaḥ snātaḥ kṛtapūrvāhṇikakriyaḥ ||
alaṃkṛtya yathā labdhairgaṃdhamālyavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarāsaṃgaḥ sarvaśuklasamāhitaḥ ||
devālaye gṛhe 'nyasmindeśe vā sumanohare | sukhenābhyastapūrveṇa tvāsanena kṛtāsanaḥ ||
tanuṃ kṛtvātmanaḥ śaivīṃ śivaśāstroktavartmanā | saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ nakulīśvaramīśvaram ||
nivedya pāyasaṃ tasmai samapyārādhanaṃ kramāt | praṇipatya ca taṃ devaṃ prāptānujñaśca tanmukhāt ||
koṭivāraṃ tadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā japecchivam | lakṣaviṃśatikaṃ vāpi daśalakṣamathāpi vā ||
tataśca pāyasākṣāralavaṇaikamitāśanaḥ | ahiṃsakaḥ kṣamī śāṃto dāṃtaścaiva sadā bhavet ||
alābhe pāyasasyāśnanphalamūlādikāni vā | vihitāni śivenaiva viśiṣṭānyuttarottaram ||
caruṃ bhakṣyamatho saktukaṇānyāvakameva ca | śākaṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ mūlaṃ phalamathodakam ||
abhimaṃtrya ca mantreṇa bhakṣyabhojyādikāni ca | sādhane 'sminviśeṣeṇa nityaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ||
mantrāṣṭaśatapūtena jalena śucinā vratī | snāyānnadīnadotthena prokṣayedvātha śaktitaḥ ||
tarpayecca tathā nityaṃ juhuyācca śivānale | saptabhiḥ pañcabhirdravyaistribhirvātha ghṛtena vā ||
itthaṃ bhaktyā śivaṃ śaivo yaḥ sādhayati sādhakaḥ | tasyehāmutra duṣprāpaṃ na kiṃcidapi vidyate ||
athavā 'haraharmaṃtraṃ japedekāgramānasaḥ | anaśnanneva sāhasraṃ vinā mantrasya sādhanam ||
na tasya durlabhaṃ kiṃcinna tasyāstyaśubhaṃ kvacit | iha vidyāṃ śriyaṃ saukhyaṃ labdhvā muktiṃ ca viṃdati ||
sādhane viniyoge ca nitye naimittike tathā | japejjalairbhasmanā ca snātvā mantreṇa ca kramāt ||
śucirbaddhaśikhassūtrī sapavitrakarastathā | dhṛtatripuṃḍrarudrākṣo vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet ||
upamanyuruvāca | athaivaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ śiṣyaṃ kṛtapāśupatavratam | ācāryatve 'bhiṣiṃceta tadyogatvena cānyathā ||
maṇḍalaṃ pūrvavatkṛttvā saṃpūjya parameśvaram | sthāpayatpañcakalaśāndikṣu madhye ca pūrvavat ||
nivṛttiṃ purato nyasya pratiṣṭhāṃ paścime ghaṭe | vidyāṃ dakṣiṇataḥ śāṃtimuttare madhyataḥ parām ||
kṛtvā rakṣādikaṃ tatra baddhvā mudrāṃ ca dhainavīm | abhimaṃtrya ghaṭānhutvā pūrṇāṃtaṃ ca yathā purā ||
praveśya maṃḍale śiṣyamanuṣṇīṣaṃ ca deśikaḥ | tarpaṇādyaṃ tu maṃtrāṇāṃ kuryātpūrvāvasānakam ||
tataḥ saṃpūjya deveśamanujñāpya ca pūrvavat | abhiṣekāya taṃ śiṣyamāsanaṃ tvadhirohayet ||
sakalīkṛtya taṃ paścātkalāpañcakarūpiṇam | nyastamaṃtratanuṃ baddhvā śivaṃ śiṣyaṃ samarpayet ||
tato nivṛttikuṃbhādighaṭānuddhṛtya vai kramāt | madhyamāntācchivenaiva śiṣyaṃ tamabhiṣecayat ||
śivahastaṃ samarpyātha śiśoḥ śirasi deśikaḥ | śivabhāvasamāpannaḥ śivācāryaṃ tamādiśet ||
athālaṃkṛtya taṃ devamārādhya śivamaṇḍale | śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hutvā dadyātpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ ||
punaḥ sampūjya deveśaṃ praṇamya bhuvi daṃḍavat | śirasyaṃjalimādhāya śivaṃ vijñāpayedguruḥ ||
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena deśikoyaṃ mayā kṛtaḥ | anugṛhya tvayā deva divyājñāsmai pradīyatām ||
evaṃ vijñāpya śiṣyeṇa saha bhūyaḥ praṇamya ca | śivaṃ śivāgamaṃ divyaṃ pūjayecchivavadguruḥ ||
punaḥ śivamanujñāpya śivajñānasya pustakam | ubhābhyāmatha pāṇibhyāṃ dadyācchiṣyāya deśikaḥ ||
sa tāmmūrdhni samādhāya vidyāṃ vidyāsanopari | adhiropya yathānyāyamabhivaṃdya samarcayet ||
atha tasmai gururdadyādrājopakaraṇānyapi | ācāryapadavīṃ prāpto rājyaṃ cāpi yato 'rhati ||
athānuśāsanaṃ kuryātpūrvairācaritaṃ yathā | yathā ca śivaśāstroktaṃ yathā lokeṣu pūjyate ||
śiṣyānparikṣya yatnena śivaśāstroktalakṣaṇaiḥ | saṃskṛtya ca śivajñānaṃ tebhyo dadyācca deśikaḥ ||
evaṃ sarvamanāyāsaṃ śaucaṃ kṣāṃtiṃ dayāṃ tathā | aspṛhāmapyasūyāṃ ca yatnena ca vibhāvayet ||
itthamādiśya taṃ śiṣyaṃ śivamudvāsya maṃḍalāt | śivakuṃbhānalādīṃśca sadasyānapi pūjayet ||
yugapadvātha saṃskārānkurvīta sagaṇo guruḥ | tatra yatra dvayaṃ vāpi prayogasyopadiśyate ||
tadādāveva kalaśānkalpayedadhvaśuddhivat | kṛtvā samayasaṃskāramabhiṣekaṃ vinākhilam ||
samabhyarcya śivaṃ bhūyaḥ kṛtvā cādhvaviśodhanam | tasminparisamāpte tu punardevaṃ prapūjayet ||
hutvā maṃtrantu saṃtarpya saṃdīpyāśāsya ceśvaram | samarpya maṃtraṃ śiṣyasya pāṇau śeṣaṃ samāpayet ||
athavā maṃtrasaṃskāramanuciṃtyākhilaṃ kramāt | adhvaśuddhiṃ guruḥ kuryādabhiṣekāvasānikam ||
tatra yaḥ śāntyatītādikalāsu vihito vidhiḥ | sa sarvo 'pi vidhātavyastattvatrayaviśodhane ||
śivavidyātmatattvākhyaṃ tattvatrayamudāhṛtam | śaktau śivastato vidyāttasyāstvātmā samudbabhau ||
śivena śāṃtyatītādhvā vyāptastadaparaḥ paraḥ | vidyayā pariśiṣṭo 'dhvā hyātmanā nikhilaḥ kramāt ||
durlabhaṃ śāṃbhavaṃ matvā maṃtramūlaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ | śāktaṃ śaṃsīta saṃskāraṃ śivaśāstrārthapāragāḥ ||
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ saṃskārākhyasya karmaṇaḥ | cāturvidhyamidaṃ kṛṣṇa kiṃ bhūya śrotumicchasi ||
kṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavañchrotumicchāmi śivāśramaniṣeviṇām | śivaśāstroditaṃ karma nityanaimittikaṃ tathā ||
upamanyuruvāca | prātarutthāya śayanāddhyātvā devaṃ sahāmbayā | vicārya kāryaṃ nirgacchedgṛhādabhyudite 'ruṇe ||
abādhe vijane deśe kuryādāvaśyakaṃ tataḥ | kṛtvā śaucaṃ vidhānena daṃtadhāvanamācaret ||
alābhe daṃtakāṣṭhānāmaṣṭamyādidineṣu ca | apāṃ dvādaśagaṇḍūṣaiḥ kuryādāsyaviśodhanam ||
ācamya vidhivatpaścādvāruṇaṃ snānamācaret | nadyāṃ vā devakhāte vā hrade vātha gṛhe 'pi vā ||
snānadravyāṇi tattīre sthāpayitvā bahirmalam | vyāpohya mṛdamālipya snātvā gomayamālipet ||
snātvā punaḥ punarvastraṃ tyaktvāvātha viśodhya ca | susnāto nṛpavadbhūyaḥ śuddhaṃ vāso vasīta ca ||
malasnānaṃ sugaṃdhādyaiḥ snānaṃ dantaviśodhanam | na kuryādbrahmacārī ca tapasvī vidhavā tathā ||
sopavītaśśikhāṃ baddhā praviśya ca jalāṃtaram | avagāhya samācāṃto jale nyasyettrimaṃḍalam ||
saumye magnaḥ punarmaṃtraṃ japecchaktyā śivaṃ smaret | utthāyācamya tenaiva svātmānamabhiṣecayet ||
gośṛṃgeṇa sadarbheṇa pālāśena dalena vā | pādmena vātha pāṇibhyāṃ pañcakṛtvastrireva vā ||
udyānādau gṛhe caiva vardhanyā kalaśena vā | avagāhanakāle 'dbhirmaṃtritairabhiṣecayet ||
atha cedvāruṇaṃ kartumaśaktaḥ śuddhavāsasā | ārdreṇa śodhayeddehamāpādatalamastakam ||
āgneyaṃ vātha vā māṃtraṃ kuryātsnānaṃ śivena vā | śivaciṃtāparaṃ snānaṃ yuktasyātmīyamucyate ||
svasūtroktavidhānena maṃtrācamanapūrvakam | ācaredbrahmayajñāṃtaṃ kṛtvā devāditarpaṇam ||
maṃḍalasthaṃ mahādevaṃ dhyātvābhyarcya yathāvidhi | dadyādarghyaṃ tatastasmai śivāyādityarūpiṇe ||
atha vaitatsvasūtroktaṃ kṛtvā hastau viśodhayet | karanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sakalīkṛtavigrahaḥ ||
vāmahastagatāṃbhobhirgaṃdhasiddhārthakānvitaiḥ | kuśapuṃjena vābhyukṣya mūlamaṃtrasamanvitaiḥ ||
āpohiṣṭhādibhirmantraiḥ śeṣamāghrāya vai jalam | vāmanāsāpuṭenaiva devaṃ saṃbhāvayetsitam ||
arghamādāya dehasthaṃ savyanāsāpuṭena ca | kṛṣṇavarṇena bāhyasthaṃ bhāvayecca śilāgatam ||
tarpayedatha devebhya ṛṣibhiśca viśeṣataḥ | bhūtebhyaśca pitṛbhyaśca dadyādarghyaṃ yathāvidhi ||
raktacaṃdanatoyena hastamātreṇa maṃḍalam | suvṛttaṃ kalpayedbhūmau raktacūrṇādyalaṃkṛtam ||
tatra saṃpūjayedbhānuṃ svakīyāvaraṇaiḥ saha | svakholkāyeti maṃtreṇa sāṃgatassukhasiddhaye ||
punaśca maṃḍalaṃ kṛtvā tadaṃgaiḥ paripūjya ca | tatra sthāpya hemapātraṃ māgadhaprasthasaṃmitam ||
pūrayedgaṃdhatoyena raktacaṃdanayoginā | raktapuṣpaistilaiścaiva kuśākṣatasamanvitaiḥ ||
dūrvāpāmārgagavyaiśca kevalena jalena vā | jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā natvā devaṃ ca maṃḍale ||
kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ dadyādarghyaṃ śivāya tat | athavāṃjalinā toyaṃ sadarbhaṃ mūlavidyayā ||
utkṣipedambarasthāya śivāyādityamūrtaye | kṛtvā punaḥ karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam ||
buddhveśānādisadyāṃtaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ śivam | gṛhītvā bhasitaṃ mantrairvimṛjyāṅgāni saṃspṛśet ||
yā dināṃtaiśśirovaktrahṛdguhyacaraṇānkramāt | tato mūlena sarvāṃgamālabhya vasanāntaram ||
paridhāya dvirācamya prokṣyaikādaśamantritaiḥ | jalairācchādya vāso 'yaddvirācamya śivaṃ smaret ||
punarnyastakaro mantrī tripuṃḍraṃ bhasmanā likhet | avakramāya taṃ vyaktaṃ lalāṭe gandhavāriṇā ||
vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā bindumardhendumeva vā | lalāṭe yādṛśaṃ puṇḍraṃ likhitaṃ bhasmanā punaḥ ||
tādṛśaṃ bhujayormūrdhni stanayoraṃtare likhet | sarvāṃgoddhūlanaṃ caiva na samānaṃ tripuṇḍrakaiḥ ||
tasmāttripuṇḍramevaikaṃ likheduddhūlanaṃ vinā | rudrākṣāndhārayedmūrdhni kaṃṭhe śrote kare tathā ||
suvarṇavarṇamacchinnaṃ śubhaṃ nānyairdhṛtaṃ śubham | viprādīnāṃ kramācchreṣṭhaṃ pītaṃ raktamathāsitam ||
tadalābhe yathālābhaṃ dhāraṇīyamadūṣitam | tatrāpi nottaraṃ nīcairdhāryaṃ nīcamathottaraiḥ ||
nāśucirdhārayedakṣaṃ sadā kāleṣu dhārayet | itthaṃ trisaṃdhyamathavā dvisaṃdhyaṃ sakṛdeva vā ||
kṛtvā snānādikaṃ śaktyā pūjayetparameśvaram | prajāsthānaṃ samāsādya baddhvā ruciramāsanam ||
dhyāyeddevaṃ ca devīṃ ca prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥ | śvetādīnnakulīśāṃtāṃstacchiṣyānpraṇamedgurum ||
punardevaṃ śivaṃ natvā tato nāmāṣṭakaṃ japet | śivo maheśvaraścaiva rudro viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaḥ ||
saṃsāravaidyassarvajñaḥ paramātmeti cāṣṭakam | athavā śivamevaikaṃ japitvaikādaśādhikam ||
jihvāgre tejaso rāśiṃ dhyātvāvyādhyādiśāṃtaye | prakṣālya caraṇau kṛtvā karau caṃdanacarcitau ||
prakurvīta karanyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam ||
adhyāya ||
upamanyuruvāca | nyāsastu trividhaḥ proktaḥ sthityutpattilayakramāt | sthitirnyāso gṛhasthānāmutpattirbrahmacāriṇām | yatīnāṃ saṃhṛtinyāso vanasthānāṃ tathaiva ca | sa eva bhartṛhīnāyāḥ kuṭuṃbinyāḥ sthitirbhavet ||
kanyāyāḥ punarutpattiṃ vakṣye nyāsasya lakṣaṇam | aṃguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāṃtaṃ sthitinyāsa udāhṛtaḥ | dakṣiṇāṃguṣṭhamārabhya vāmāṃguṣṭhāntameva ca | utpattinyāsa ākhyāto viparītastu saṃhṛtiḥ ||
sabiṃdukānnakārādīnvarṇānnyasyedanukramāt | aṃgulīṣu śivaṃ nyasyettalayorapyanāmayoḥ | astranyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā daśadikṣvastramaṃtrataḥ | nivṛttyādikalāḥ pañca pañcabhūtasvarūpiṇīḥ ||
pañcabhūtādhipaissārdhaṃ tataccihnasamanvitāḥ | hṛtkaṇṭatālubhrūmadhyabrahmarandhrasamāśrayāḥ | tadtadbījena saṃgraṃthīstadtadbījeṣu bhāvayet | tāsāṃ viśodhanārthāya vidyāṃ pañcākṣarīṃ japet ||
niruddhvā prāṇavāyuṃ ca guṇasaṃkhyānusārataḥ | bhūtagraṃthiṃ tataśchidyādastreṇaivāstramudrayā | nāḍyā suṣumnayātmānaṃ preritaṃ prāṇavāyunā | nirgataṃ brahmarandhreṇa yojayecchivatejasā ||
viśoṣya vāyunā paścāddehaṃ kālāgninā dahet | tataścoparibhāvena kalāssaṃhṛtya vāyunā | dehaṃ saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaṃ kalāsspṛṣṭvā sahābdhinā | plāvayitvāmṛtairdehaṃ yathāsthānaṃ niveśayet ||
atha saṃhṛtya vai dagdhaḥ kalāsargaṃ vinaiva tu | amṛtaplāvanaṃ kuryādbhasmībhūtasya vai tataḥ | tato vidyāmaye tasmindehe dīpaśikhākṛtim | śivānnirgatamātmānaṃ brahmaraṃdhreṇa yojayet ||
dehasyāntaḥ praviṣṭaṃ taṃ dhyātvā hṛdayapaṃkaje | punaścāmṛtavarṣeṇa siṃcedvidyāmayaṃ vapuḥ | tataḥ kuryātkaranyāsaṃ karaśodhanapūrvakam | dehanyāsaṃ tataḥ paścānmahatyā mudrayā caret ||
aṃganyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā śivoktena tu vartmanā | varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhastapādādisaṃdhiṣu | ṣaḍaṃgāni tato nyasya jātiṣaṭkayutāni ca | digbaṃdhamācaretpaścādāgneyādi yathākramam ||
yadvā mūrdhādipañcāṃgaṃ nyāsameva samācaret | tathā ṣaḍaṃganyāsaṃ ca bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ vinā | evaṃ samāsarūpeṇa kṛtvā dehātmaśodhanam | śivabhāvamupāgamya pūjayetparameśvaram ||
atha yasyāstyavasaro nāsti vā mativibhramaḥ | sa vistīrṇena kalpena nyāsakarma samācaret | tatrādyo mātṛkānyāso brahmanyāsastataḥ paraḥ | tṛtīyaḥ praṇavanyāso haṃsanyāsastaduttaraḥ ||
pañcamaḥ kathyate sadbhirnyāsaḥ pañcākṣarātmakaḥ | eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā kuryātpūjādi karmasu | akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ ca lalāṭake | iṃ īṃ ca netrayostadvatuṃ ūṃ śravaṇayostathā ||
ṛṃ ḥṃ kapolayoścaiva ḷaṃ ḹṃ nāsāpuṭadvaye | ememoṣṭhadvayoromauṃ daṃtapaṃktidvayoḥ kramāt | aṃ jihvāyāmatho tālunyaḥ prayojyo yathākramam | kavargaṃ dakṣiṇe haste nyasetpañcasu saṃdhiṣu ||
cavargaṃ ca tathā vāmahastasaṃdhiṣu vinyaset | ṭavargaṃ ca tavargaṃ ca pādayorubhayorapi | paphau tu pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhe nābhau cāpi babhau tataḥ | nyasenmakāraṃ hṛdaye tvagādiṣu yathākramam ||
yakarādisakārāṃtānnyasetsaptasu dhātuṣu | haṃkāraṃ hṛdayasyāṃtaḥ kṣakāraṃ bhrūyugāṃtare | evaṃ varṇānpravinyasya pañcāśadrudravartmanā | aṃgavaktrakalābhedātpañca brahmāṇi vinyaset ||
karanyāsādyamapi taiḥ kṛtvā vātha na vā kramāt | śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣvetāni kalpayet | tataścordhvādivaktrāṇi paścimāṃtāni kalpayet | īśānasya kalāḥ pañca pañcasveteṣu ca kramāt ||
tataścaturṣu vaktreṣu puruṣasya kalā api | catasraḥ praṇidhātavyāḥ pūrvādikramayogataḥ | hṛtkaṃṭhāṃseṣu nābhau ca kukṣau pṛṣṭhe ca vakṣasi | aghorasya kalāścāṣṭau pādayorapi hastayoḥ ||
paścāttrayoḥdaśakalāḥ pāyumeḍhrorujānuṣu | jaṃghāsphikkaṭipārśveṣu vāmadevasya bhāvayet | ghrāṇe śirasi bāhvośca kalpayetkalpavittamaḥ | aṣṭatriṃśatkalānyāsamevaṃ kṛtvānupūrvaśaḥ ||
paścātpraṇavaviddhīmānpraṇavanyāsamācaret | bāhudvaye kūrparayostathā ca maṇibandhayoḥ | pārśvodarorujaṃgheṣu pādayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastathā | itthaṃ praṇavavinyāsaṃ kṛtvā nyāsavicakṣaṇaḥ ||
haṃsanyāsaṃ prakurvīta śivaśāstre yathoditam | bījaṃ vibhajya haṃsasya netrayorghrāṇayorapi | vibhajya bāhunetrāsyalalāṭe ghrāṇayorapi | kakṣayoḥ skandhayoścaiva pārśvayostanayostathā ||
kaṭhyoḥ pāṇyorgulphayośca yadvā pañcāṃgavartmanā | haṃsanyāsamimaṃ kṛtvā nyasetpañcākṣarīṃ tataḥ | yathā pūrvoktamārgeṇa śivatvaṃ yena jāyate | nāśivaḥ śivamabhyasyennāśivaḥ śivamarcayet ||
nāśivastu śivaṃ dhyāyennāśivamprāpnuyācchivam | tasmācchaivīṃ tanuṃ kṛtvā tyaktvā ca paśubhāvanām | śivo 'hamiti saṃcintya śaivaṃ karma samācaret | karmayajñastapoyajño japayajñastaduttaraḥ ||
dhyānayajño jñānayajñaḥ pañca yajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ | karmayajñaratāḥ kecittapoyajñaratāḥ pare | japayajñaratāścānye dhyānayajñaratāstathā ||
jñānayajñaratāścānye viśiṣṭāścottarottaram | kramayajño dvidhā proktaḥ kāmākāmavibhedataḥ | kāmānkāmī tato bhuktvā kāmāsaktaḥ punarbhavet | akāme rudrabhavane bhogānbhuktvā tataścyutaḥ ||
tapoyajñarato bhūtvā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ | tapasvī ca punastasminbhogān bhuktvā tataścyutaḥ | japadhyānarato bhūtvā jāyate bhuvi mānavaḥ | japadhyānarato martyastadvaiśiṣṭyavaśādiha ||
jñānaṃ labdhvācirādeva śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt | tasmānmukto śivājñaptaḥ karmayajño 'pi dehinām | akāmaḥ kāmasaṃyukto bandhāyaiva bhaviṣyati | tasmātpañcasu yajñeṣu dhyānajñānaparo bhavet ||
dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ ca yasyāsti tīrṇastena bhavārṇavaḥ | hiṃsādidoṣanirmukto viśuddhaścittasādhanaḥ | dhyānayajñaḥ parastasmādapavargaphalapradaḥ | bahiḥ karmakarā yadvannātīva phalabhāginaḥ ||
dṛṣṭvā narendrabhavane tadvadatrāpi karmiṇaḥ | dhyānināṃ hi vapuḥ sūkṣmaṃ bhavetpratyakṣamaiśvaram | yatheha karmaṇāṃ sthūlaṃ mṛtkāṣṭhādyaiḥ prakalpitam | dhyānayajñaratāstasmāddevānpāṣāṇamṛṇmayān ||
nātyaṃtaṃ pratipadyaṃte śivayāthātmyavedanāt | ātmasthaṃ yaḥ śivaṃ tyaktvā bahirabhyarcayennaraḥ | hastasthaṃ phalamutsṛjya lihetkūrparamātmanaḥ | jñānāddhyānaṃ bhaveddhyānājjñānaṃ bhūyaḥ pravartate ||
tadubhābhyāṃ bhavenmuktistasmāddhyānarato bhavet | dvādaśānte tathā mūrdhni lalāṭe bhrūyugāntare | nāsāgre vā tathāsye vā kandhare hṛdaye tathā | nābhau vā śāśvatasthāne śraddhāviddhena cetasā ||
bahiryāgopacāreṇa devaṃ devīṃ ca pūjayet | athavā pūjayennityaṃ liṃge vā kṛtakepi vā | vahnau vā sthaṇḍile vātha bhaktyā vittānusārataḥ | athavāṃtarbahiścaiva pūjayetparameśvaram | aṃtaryāgarataḥ pūjāṃ bahiḥ kurvīta vā na vā ||
upamanyuruvāca | vyākhyāṃ pūjāvidhānasya pravadāmi samāsataḥ | śivaśāstre śivenaiva śivāyai kathitasya tu ||
aṃgamabhyaṃtaraṃ yāgamagnikāryāvasānakam | vidhāya vā na vā paścādbahiryāgaṃ samācaret ||
tatra dravyāṇi manasā kalpayitvā viśodhya ca | dhyātvā vināyakaṃ devaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva naṃdīśaṃ suyaśaṃ tathā | ārādhya manasā samyagāsanaṃ kalpayedbudhaḥ ||
ārādhanādikairyuktassiṃhayogāsanādikam | padmāsanaṃ vā vimalaṃ tattvatrayasamanvitam ||
tasyopari śivaṃ dhyāyetsāṃbaṃ sarvamanoharam | sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvāvayavaśobhanam ||
sarvātiśayasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | raktāsyapāṇicaraṇaṃ kuṃdacaṃdrasmitānanam ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ phullapadmatrilocanam | caturbhujamudārāṅgaṃ cārucaṃdrakalādharam ||
varadābhayahastaṃ ca mṛgaṭaṃkadharaṃ haram | bhujaṃgahāravalayaṃ cārunīlagalāṃtaram ||
sarvopamānarahitaṃ sānugaṃ saparicchadam | tataḥ saṃciṃtayettasya vāmabhāge maheśvarīm ||
praphullotpalapatrābhāṃ vistīrṇāyatalocanām | pūrṇacaṃdrābhavadanāṃ nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajām ||
nīlotpaladalaprakhyāṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharām | ativṛttaghanottuṃgasnigdhapīnapayodharām ||
tanumadhyāṃ pṛthuśroṇīṃ pītasūkṣmavarāmbarām | sarvābharaṇasaṃpannāṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalām ||
vicitrapuṣpasaṃkīrṇakeśapāśopaśobhitām | sarvato 'nuguṇākārāṃ kiṃcillajjānatānanām ||
hemāraviṃdaṃ vilasaddadhānāṃ dakṣiṇe kare | daṃḍavaccāparaṃ haste nyasyāsīnāṃ mahāsane ||
pāśavicchedikāṃ sākṣātsaccidānaṃdarūpiṇīm | evaṃ devaṃ ca devīṃ ca dhyātvāsanavare śubhe ||
sarvopacāravadbhaktyā bhāvapuṣpaissamarcayet | athavā parikalpyaivaṃ mūrtimanyatamāṃ vibhoḥ ||
śaivīṃ sadāśivākhyāṃ vā tathā māheśvarīṃ parām | ṣaḍviṃśakābhidhānāṃ vā śrīkaṃṭhākhyāmathāpi vā ||
mantranyāsādikāṃ cāpi kṛtvā svasyāṃ tanau yathā | asyāṃ mūrtau mūrtimaṃtaṃ śivaṃ sadasataḥ param ||
dhyātvā bāhyakrameṇaiva pūjāṃ nirvartayeddhiyā | samidājyādibhiḥ paścānnābhau homaṃ ca bhāvayet ||
bhrūmadhye ca śivaṃ dhyāyecchuddhadīpaśikhākṛtim | itthamaṃge svataṃtre vā yoge dhyānamaye śubhe ||
agnikāryāvasānaṃ ca sarvatraiva samo vidhiḥ | atha ciṃtāmayaṃ sarvaṃ samāpyārādhanakramam ||
liṃge ca pūjayeddevaṃ sthaṃḍile vānale 'pi vā ||
upamanyuruvāca | prokṣayenmūlamaṃtreṇa pūjāsthānaṃ viśuddhaye | gandhacandanatoyena puṣpaṃ tatra vinikṣipet ||
astreṇotsārya vai vighnānavaguṇṭhya ca varmaṇā | astraṃ dikṣu pravinyasya kalpayedarcanābhuvam ||
tatra darbhānparistīrya kṣālayetprokṣaṇādibhiḥ | saṃśodhya sarvapātrāṇi dravyaśuddhiṃ samācaret ||
prokṣaṇīmardhyapātraṃ ca pādyapātramataḥ param | tathaivācamanīyasya pātraṃ ceti catuṣṭayam ||
prakṣālya prokṣya vīkṣyātha kṣipetteṣu jalaṃ śivam | puṇyadravyāṇi sarvāṇi yathālābhaṃ vinikṣipet ||
ratnāni rajataṃ hema gandhapuṣpākṣatādayaḥ | phalapallavadarbhāṃśca puṇyadravyāṇyanekadhā ||
snānodake sugandhādi pānīye ca viśeṣataḥ | śītalāni manojñānī kusumādīni nikṣipet ||
uśīraṃ candanaṃ caiva pādye tu parikalpayet | jātikaṃkolakarpūrabahumūlatamālakān ||
kṣipedācamanīye ca cūrṇayitvā viśeṣataḥ | elāṃ pātreṣu sarveṣu karpūraṃ candanaṃ tathā ||
kuśāgrāṇyakṣatāṃścaiva yavavrīhitilānapi | ājyasiddhārthapuṣpāṇi bhasitañcārghyapātrake ||
kuśapuṣpayavavrīhibahumūlatamālakān | prakṣipetprokṣaṇīpātre bhasitaṃ ca yathākramam ||
sarvatra mantraṃ vinyasya varmaṇāveṣṭya bāhyataḥ | paścādastreṇa saṃrakṣya dhenumudrāṃ pradarśayet ||
pūjādravyāṇi sarvāṇi prokṣaṇīpātravāriṇā | samprokṣya mūlamaṃtreṇa śodhayedvidhivattataḥ ||
pātrāṇāṃ prokṣaṇīmekāmalābhe sarvakarmasu | sādhayedarghyamadbhistatsāmānyaṃ sādhakottamaḥ ||
tato vināyakaṃ devaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādibhiḥ kramāt | pūjayitvā vidhānena dvārapārśve 'tha dakṣiṇe ||
antaḥpurādhipaṃ sākṣānnandinaṃ samyagarcayet | cāmīkarācalaprakhyaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam ||
bālendumukuṭaṃ saumyaṃ trinetraṃ ca caturbhujam | dīptaśūlamṛgīṭaṃkatigmavetradharaṃ prabhum ||
candrabimbābhavadanaṃ harivaktramathāpi vā | uttare dvārapārśvasya bhāryāṃ ca marutāṃ sutām ||
suyaśāṃ suvratāmambāṃ pādamaṇḍanatatparām | pūjayitvā praviśyāntarbhavanaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ ||
saṃpūjya liṅgaṃ tairdravyairnirmālyamapanodayet | prakṣālya puṣpaṃ śirasi nyasettasya viśuddhaye ||
puṣpahasto japecchaktyā mantraṃ mantraviśuddhaye | aiśānyāṃ caṇdamārādhya nirmālyaṃ tasya dāpayet ||
kalpayedāsanaṃ paścādādhārādi yathākramam | ādhāraśaktiṃ kalyāṇīṃ śyāmāṃ dhyāyedadho bhuvi ||
tasyāḥ purastādutkaṃṭhamanaṃtaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim | dhavalaṃ pañcaphaṇinaṃ lelihānamivāmbaram ||
tasyoparyāsanaṃ bhadraṃ kaṇṭhīravacatuṣpadam | dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryañca padāni vai ||
āgneyādiśvetaraktapītaśyāmāni varṇataḥ | adharmādīni pūrvādīnyuttarāṃtānyanukramāt ||
rājāvartamaṇiprakhyānnyasya gātrāṇi bhāvayet | asyordhvacchādanaṃ padmamāsanaṃ vimalaṃ sitam ||
aṣṭapatrāṇi tasyāhuraṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam | kesarāṇi ca vāmādyā rudrāvāmādiśaktibhiḥ ||
bījānyapi ca tā eva śaktayoṃtarmanonmanīḥ | karṇikāparavairāgyaṃ nālaṃ jñānaṃ śivātmakam ||
kandaśca śivadharmātmā karṇikānte trimaṇḍale | trimaṇḍaloparyātmādi tattvatritayamāsanam ||
sarvāsanopari sukhaṃ vicitrāstaraṇāstṛtam | āsanaṃ kalpayeddivyaṃ śuddhavidyāsamujjvalam ||
āvāhanaṃ sthāpanaṃ ca sannirodhaṃ nirīkṣaṇam | namaskāraṃ ca kurvīta badhvā mudrāḥ pṛthakpṛthak ||
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ tataḥ param | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca tāṃbūlaṃ dattvātha svāpayecchivau ||
athavā parikalpyaivamāsanaṃ mūrtimeva ca | sakalīkṛtya mūlena brahmābhiścāparaistathā ||
āvāhayettato devyā śivaṃ paramakāraṇam | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ devaṃ niścalamakṣaram ||
kāraṇaṃ sarvalokānāṃ sarvalokamayaṃ param | aṃtarbahiḥsthitaṃ vyāpya hyaṇoraṇu mahattaram 2 ||
bhaktānāmaprayatnena dṛśyamīśvaramavyayam | brahmeṃdraviṣṇurudrādyairapi devairagocaram ||
devasāraṃ ca vidvadbhiragocaramiti śrutam | ādimadhyāntarahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhavarogiṇām ||
śivatattvamiti khyātaṃ śivārthaṃ jagati sthiram | pañcopacāravadbhaktyā pūjayelliṃgamuttamam ||
liṃgamūrtirmaheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ | snānakāle prakurvīta jayaśabdādimaṃgalam ||
pañcagavyaghṛtakṣīradadhimadhvādipūrvakaiḥ | mūlaiḥ phalānāṃ sāraiśca tilasarṣapasaktubhiḥ ||
bījairyavādibhiśśastaiścūrṇairmāṣādisaṃbhavaiḥ | saṃsnāpyālipya piṣṭādyaiḥ snāpayeduṣṇavāribhiḥ ||
gharṣayedvilvapatrādyairlepagaṃdhāpanuttaye | punaḥ saṃsnāpya salilaiścakravartyupacārataḥ ||
sugaṃdhāmalakaṃ dadyāddharidrāṃ ca yathākramam | tataḥ saṃśodhya salilairliṃgaṃ beramathāpi vā ||
snāpayedgaṃdhatoyena kuśapuṣpodakena ca | hiraṇyaratnatoyaiśca maṃtrasiddhairyathākramam ||
asaṃbhave tu dravyāṇāṃ yathāsaṃbhavasaṃbhṛtaiḥ | kevalairmaṃtratoyairvā snāpayecchraddhayā śivam ||
kalaśenātha śaṃkhena vardhanyā pāṇinā tathā | sakuśena sapuṣpeṇa snāpayenmaṃtrapūrvakam ||
pavamānena rudreṇa nīlena tvaritena ca | liṃgasūktādisūktaiśca śirasātharvaṇena ca ||
ṛgbhiśca sāmabhiḥ śaivairbrahmabhiścāpi pañcabhiḥ | snāpayeddevadeveśaṃ śivena praṇavena ca ||
yathā devasya devyāśca kuryātsnānādikaṃ tathā | na tu kaścidviśeṣo 'sti tatra tau sadṛśau yataḥ ||
prathamaṃ devamuddiśya kṛtvā snānādikāḥ kriyāḥ | devyaiḥ praścātprakurvīta devadevasya śāsanāt ||
ardhanārīśvare pūjye paurvāparyaṃ na vidyate | tatra tatropacārāṇāṃ liṃge vānyatra vā kvacit ||
kṛtvā 'bhiṣekaṃ liṃgasya śucinā ca sugaṃdhinā | saṃmṛjya vāsasā dadyādaṃbaraṃ copavītakam ||
pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ gaṃdhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca bhūṣaṇam | dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ pānīyaṃ mukhaśodhanam ||
punaścācamanīyaṃ ca mukhavāsaṃ tataḥ param | mukuṭaṃ ca śubhaṃ bhadraṃ sarvaratnairalaṃkṛtam ||
bhūṣaṇāni pavitrāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca | vyajane cāmare chatraṃ tālavṛṃtaṃ ca darpaṇam ||
dattvā nīrājanaṃ kuryātsarvamaṃgalanisvanaiḥ | gītanṛtyādibhiścaiva jayaśabdasamanvitaḥ ||
haime ca rājate tāmre pātre vā mṛnmaye śubhe | padmakaiśśobhitaiḥ puṣpairbījairdadhyakṣatādibhiḥ ||
triśūlaśaṃkhayugmābjanandyāvartaiḥ karīṣajaiḥ | śrīvatsasvastikādarśavajrairvahnyādicihnitaiḥ ||
aṣṭau pradīpānparito vidhāyaikaṃ tu madhyame | teṣu vāmādikāścintyāḥ pūjyāśca nava śaktayaḥ ||
kavacena samācchādya saṃrakṣyāstreṇa sarvataḥ | dhenumudrāṃ ca saṃdarśya pāṇibhyāṃ pātramuddharet ||
athavāropayetpātre pañcadīpānyathākramam | vidikṣvapi ca madhye ca dīpamekamathāpi vā ||
tatastatpātramuddhṛtya liṃgāderupari kramāt | triḥ pradakṣiṇayogena bhrāmayenmūlavidyayā ||
dadyādarghyaṃ tato mūrdhni bhasitaṃ ca sugaṃdhitam | kṛtvā puṣpāṃjaliṃ paścādupahārānnivedayet ||
pānīyaṃ ca tato dadyāddattvā vācamanaṃ punaḥ | pañcasaugaṃdhikopetaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca nivedayet ||
prokṣayetprokṣaṇīyāni gānanāṭyāni kārayet | liṃgādau śivayościntāṃ kṛtvā śaktyajapecchivam ||
pradakṣiṇaṃ praṇāmaṃ ca stavaṃ cātmasamarpaṇam | vijñāpanaṃ ca kāryāṇāṃ kuryādvinayapūrvakam ||
arghyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ dattvā baddhvā mudrāṃ yathāvidhi | paścātkṣamāpayeddevamudvāsyātmani ciṃtayet ||
pādyādimukhavāsāṃtamarghyādyaṃ cātisaṃkaṭe | puṣpavikṣepamātraṃ vā kuryādbhāvapurassaram ||
tāvataiva paro dharmo bhāvane sukṛto bhavet | asaṃpūjya na bhuñjīta śivamāprāṇasaṃcarāt ||
yadi pāpastu bhuṃjīta svairaṃ taysa na niṣkṛtiḥ | pramādena tu bhuṃkte cettadudgīrya prayatnataḥ ||
snātvā dviguṇamabhyarcya devaṃ devīmupoṣya ca | śivasyāyutamabhyasyedbrahmacaryapurassaram ||
paredyuśśaktito dattvā suvarṇādyaṃ śivāya ca | śivabhaktāya vā kṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ śucirbhavet ||
upamanyuruvāca | anuktaṃ cātra pūjāyāḥ kamalopabhayādiva | yattadanyatpravakṣyāmi samāsānna tu vistarāt ||
havirnivedanātpūrvaṃ dīpadānādanantaram | kuryādāvaraṇābhyarcāṃ prāpte nīrājane 'tha vā ||
tatreśānādisadyāṃtaṃ rudrādyastrāṃtameva ca | śivasya vā śivāyāśca prathamāvaraṇe japet ||
aiśānyāṃ pūrvabhāge ca dakṣiṇe cottare tathā | paścime ca tathāgneyyāmaiśānyāṃ nairṛte tathā ||
vāyavyāṃ punaraiśānyāṃ caturdikṣu tataḥ param | garbhāvaraṇamākhyātaṃ mantrasaṃghātameva vā ||
hṛdayādyastraparyaṃtamathavāpi samarcayet | tadbahiḥ pūrvataḥ śakraṃ yamaṃ dakṣiṇato yajet ||
varuṇaṃ vāruṇe bhāge dhanadaṃ cottare budhaḥ | īśamaiśe 'nalaṃ svīye nairṛte nirṛtiṃ yajet ||
mārute mārutaṃ viṣṇuṃ nairṛte vidhimaiśvare | bahiḥpadmasya vajrādyānyabjāṃtānyāyudhānyapi ||
prasiddharūpāṇyāśāsu lokeśānāṃ kramādyajet | devaṃ devīṃ ca saṃprekṣya sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ ||
baddhāṃjalipuṭā dhyeyāḥ samāsīnā yathāsukham | sarvāvaraṇadevānāṃ svābhidhānairnamoyutaiḥ ||
puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjanaṃ kuryānnatvā sarvānyathākramam | garbhāvaraṇamevāpi yajetsvāvaraṇena vā ||
yoge dhyāne jape home vāhye vābhyaṃtare 'pi vā | haviśca ṣaḍvidhaṃ deyaṃ śuddhaṃ mudgānnameva ca ||
pāyasaṃ dadhisaṃmiśraṃ gauḍaṃ ca madhunāplutam | eteṣvekamanekaṃ vā nānāvyaṃjanasaṃyutam ||
guḍakhaṃḍanvitaṃ dadyānmathitaṃ dadhi cottamam | bhakṣyāṇyapūpamukhyāni svādumaṃti phalāni ca ||
raktacandanapuṣpāḍhyaṃ pānīyaṃ cātiśītalam | mṛdu elārasāktaṃ ca khaṇḍaṃ pūgaphalasya ca ||
dalāni nāgavallyāśca yuktāni khadirādibhiḥ | gaurāṇi svarṇavarṇāni vihitāni śivāni ca ||
śailameva sitaṃ cūrṇaṃ nātirūkṣaṃ na dūṣitam | karpūraṃ cātha kaṃkolaṃ jātyādi ca navaṃ śubham ||
ālepanaṃ candanaṃ syānmūlakāṣṭhaṃrajomayam | kastūrikā kuṃkumaṃ ca raso mṛgamadātmakaḥ ||
puṣpāṇi surabhīṇyeva pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca | nirgaṃdhānyugragaṃdhāni dūṣitānyuṣitāni ca ||
svayameva viśīrṇāni na deyāni śivārcane | vāsāṃsi ca mṛdūnyeva tapanīyamayāni ca ||
vidyudvalayakalpāni bhūṣaṇāni viśeṣataḥ | sarvāṇyetāni karpūraniryāsāgurucandanaiḥ ||
ādhūpitāni puṣpaughairvāsitāni samaṃtataḥ | candanāgurukarpūrakāṣṭhaguggulucūrṇikaiḥ ||
ghṛtena madhunā caiva siddho dhūpaḥ praśasyate | kapilāsambhavenaiva ghṛtenātisugandhinā ||
nityaṃ pradīpitā dīpāḥ śastāḥ karpūrasaṃyutāḥ | pañcagavyaṃ ca madhuraṃ payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ tathā ||
kapilāsambhavaṃ śambhoriṣṭaṃ snāne ca pānake | āsanāni ca bhadrāṇi gajadaṃtamayāni ca ||
suvarṇaratnayuktāni citrāṇyāstaraṇāni ca | mṛdūpadhānayuktāni sūkṣmatūlamayāni ca ||
uccāvacāni ramyāṇi śayanāni sukhāni ca | nadyassamudragāminyā naṭādvāmbhaḥ samāhṛtam ||
śītañca vastrapūtaṃ tadviśiṣṭaṃ snānapānayoḥ | chatraṃ śaśinibhaṃ cāru muktādāmavirājitam ||
navaratnacitaṃ divyaṃ hemadaṇḍamanoharam | cāmare ca site sūkṣme cāmīkarapariṣkṛte ||
rājahaṃsadvayākāre ratnadaṃḍopaśobhite | darpaṇaṃ cāpi susnigdhaṃ divyagandhānulepanam ||
samaṃtādratnasañchannaṃ sragvairaiścāpi bhūṣitam | gambhīraninadaḥ śaṃkho haṃsakuṃdendusannibhaḥ ||
āsvapṛṣṭhādideśeṣu ratnacāmīkarācitaḥ | kāhalāni ca ramyāṇi nānānādakarāṇi ca ||
suvarṇanirmitānyeva mauktikālaṃkṛtāni ca | bherīmṛdaṃgamurajatimicchapaṭahādayaḥ ||
samudrakalpasannādāḥ kalpanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | bhāṃḍānyapi ca ramyāṇi patrāṇyapi ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
tadādhārāṇi 1 sarvāṇi sauvarṇānyeva sādhayet | ālayaṃ ca maheśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ ||
rājāvasathavatkalpyaṃ śilpaśāstroktalakṣaṇam | uccaprākārasaṃbhinnaṃ bhūdharākāragopuram ||
anekaratnasaṃcchannaṃ hemadvārakapāṭakam | taptajāṃbūnadamayaṃ ratnastambhaśatāvṛtam ||
muktādāmavitānāḍhyaṃ vidrumadvāratoraṇam | cāmīkaramayairdivyairmukuṭaiḥ kumbhalakṣaṇaiḥ ||
alaṃkṛtaśirobhāgamastra 2 ājena cihnitam | rājanyārhanivāsaiśca rājavīthyādiśobhitaiḥ ||
procchritaprāṃśuśikharaiḥ prāsādaiśca samaṃtataḥ | āsthānasthānavaryaiśca sthitairdikṣu vidikṣu ca ||
atyantālaṃkṛtaprāṃtamaṃtarāvaraṇairiva | uttamastrīsahasraiśca nṛtyageyaviśāradaiḥ ||
veṇuvīṇāvidagdhaiśca puruṣairbahubhiryutam | rakṣitaṃ rakṣibhirvīrairgajavājirathānvitaiḥ ||
anekapuṣpavāṭībhiranekaiśca sarovaraiḥ | dīrghikābhiranekābhirdigvidikṣu virājitam ||
vedavedāṃtatattvajñaiśśivaśāstraparāyaṇaiḥ | śivāśramaratairbhaktaiḥ śivaśāstroktalakṣaṇaiḥ ||
śāṃtaiḥ smitamukhaiḥ sphītaiḥ sadācāraparāyaṇaiḥ | śaivairmāheśvaraiścaiva śrīmadbhissevitadvijaiḥ ||
evamaṃtarbahirvāthayathāśaktivinirmitaiḥ | sthāne śilāmaye dāṃte dārave ceṣṭakāmaye ||
kevalaṃ mṛnmaye vāpi puṇyāraṇye 'tha vā girau | nadyāṃ devālaye 'nyatra deśe vātha gṛhe śubhe ||
āḍhyo vātha daridro vā svakāṃ śaktimavaṃcayan | dravyairnyāyārjitaireva bhaktyā devaṃ samarcayet ||
athānyāyārjitaiścāpi bhaktyā cecchivamarcayet | na tasya pratyavāyo 'sti bhāvavaśyo yataḥ prabhuḥ ||
nyāyārjitairapi dravyairabhaktyā pūjayedyadi | na tatphalamavāpnoti bhaktirevātra kāraṇam ||
bhaktyā vittānusāreṇa śivamuddiśya yatkṛtam | alpe mahati vā tulyaṃ phalamāḍhyadaridrayoḥ ||
bhaktyā pracoditaḥ kuryādalpavittopi mānavaḥ | mahāvibhavasāropi na kuryādbhaktivarjitaḥ ||
sarvasvamapi yo dadyācchive bhaktivivarjitaḥ | na tena phalabhāksa syādbhaktirevātra kāraṇam ||
na tattapobhiratyugrairna ca sarvairmahāmakhaiḥ | gacchecchivapuraṃ divyaṃ muktvā bhaktiṃ śivātmakam ||
guhyādguhyataraṃ kṛṣṇa sarvatra parameśvare | śive bhaktirna saṃdehastayā bhakto vimucyate ||
śivamaṃtrajapo dhyānaṃ homo yajñastapaḥśrutam | dānamadhyayanaṃ sarve bhāvārthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
bhāvahīno narassarvaṃ kṛtvāpi na vimucyate | bhāvayuktaḥ punassarvamakṛtvāpi vimucyate ||
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraiśca prājāpatyaśataistathā | māsopavāsaiścānyaiśca śivabhaktasya kiṃ punaḥ ||
abhaktā mānavāścāsmiṃlloke giriguhāsu ca | tapaṃti cālpabhogārthaṃ bhakto bhāvena mucyate ||
sāttvikaṃ muktidaṃ karma sattve vai yoginaḥ sthitāḥ | rājasaṃ siddhidaṃ kuryuḥ karmiṇo rajasāvṛtāḥ ||
asurā rākṣasāścaiva tamoguṇasamanvitāḥ | aihikārthaṃ yajantīśaṃ narāścānye 'pi tādṛśāḥ ||
tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ vāpi sāttvikaṃ bhāvameva ca | āśritya bhaktyā pūjādyaṃ kurvanbhadraṃ samaśnute ||
yataḥ pāpārṇavāttrātuṃ bhaktirnauriva nirmitā | tasmādbhaktyupapannasya rajasā tamasā ca kim ||
antyajo vādhamo vāpi mūrkho vā patito 'pi vā | śivaṃ prapannaścetkṛṣṇa pūjyassarvasurāsuraiḥ ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhaktyaiva śivamarcayet | abhuktānāṃ kvacidapi phalaṃ nāsti yatastataḥ ||
vakṣyāmyatirahasyaṃ te śṛṇu kṛṣṇa vaco mama | vedaiśśāstrairvedavidbhirvicārya suviniścitam ||
upamanyuruvāca | brahmaghno vā surāpo vā steyīvā gurutalpagaḥ | mātṛhā pitṛhā vāpi vīrahā bhrūṇahāpi vā ||
saṃpūjyāmantrakaṃ bhaktyā śivaṃ paramakāraṇam | taistaiḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyeta varṣairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena patito 'pi yajecchivam | bhaktaścennāparaḥ kaścidbhikṣāhāro jiteṃdriyaḥ ||
kṛtvāpi sumahatpāpaṃ bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇa tu | pūjayedyadi deveśaṃ tasmātpāpātpramucyate ||
abbhakṣā vāyubhakṣāśca ye cānye vratakarśitāḥ | teṣāmetairvratairnāsti śivalokasamāgamaḥ ||
bhaktyā pañcākṣareṇaiva yaḥ śivaṃ sakṛdarcayet | sopi gacchecchivasthānaṃ śivamantrasya gauravāt ||
tasmāttapāṃsi yajñāṃśca sarve sarvasvadakṣiṇāḥ | śivamūrtyarcanasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥ ||
baddho vāpyatha mukto vā paścātpañcākṣareṇa cet | pūjayanmucyate bhakto nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||
arudro vā sarudro vā sūktena śivamarcayet | yaḥ sakṛtpatito vāpimūḍho vā mucyate naraḥ ||
ṣaḍakṣareṇa vā devaṃ sūktamantreṇa pūjayet | śivabhakto jitakrodho hyalabdho labdha eva ca ||
alabdhāllabdha evātra viśiṣṭo nātra saṃśayaḥ | sa brahmāṃgena vā tena sahaṃsena vimucyate ||
tasmānnityaṃ śivaṃ bhaktyā sūktamantreṇa pūjayet | ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā trikālaṃ nityameva vā ||
ye 'rcayaṃti mahādevaṃ vijñeyāste maheśvarāḥ | jñānenātmasahāyena nārcito bhagavāñchivaḥ ||
sa ciraṃ saṃsaratyasminsaṃsāre duḥkhasāgare | durllabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ mūḍho nārcayate śivam ||
niṣphalaṃ tasya tajjanma mokṣāya na bhavedyataḥ | durllabhaṃ prāpya mānuṣyaṃ ye 'rcayanti pinākinam ||
teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ | bhavabhaktiparā ye ca bhavapraṇatacetasaḥ ||
bhavasaṃsmaraṇodyuktā na te duḥkhasya bhāginaḥ | bhavanāni manojñāni vibhramābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ ||
dhanaṃ cātṛptiparyantaṃ śivapūjāvidheḥ phalam | ye vāñchanti mahābhogānrājyaṃ ca tridaśālaye ||
te vāñchanti sadākālaṃ harasya caraṇāmbujam | saubhāgyaṃ kāntimadrūpaṃ sattvaṃ tyāgārdrabhāvatā ||
śauryaṃ vai jagati khyātiśśivamarcayato bhavet | tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya śivaikāhitamānasaḥ ||
śivapūjāvidhiṃ kuryādyadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ | tvaritaṃ jīvitaṃ yāti tvaritaṃ yāti yauvanam ||
tvaritaṃ vyādhirabhyeti tasmātpūjyaḥ pinākadhṛk | yāvannāyāti maraṇaṃ yāvannākramate jarā ||
yāvannendriyavaikalyaṃ tāvatpūjaya śaṃkaram | na śivārcanatulyo 'sti dharmo 'nyo bhuvanatraye ||
iti vijñāya yatnena pūjanīyassadāśivaḥ | dvārayāgaṃ javanikāṃ parivārabalikriyām ||
nityotsavaṃ ca kurvīta prasāde yadi pūjayet | havirnivedanādūrdhvaṃ svayaṃ cānucaro 'pi vā ||
prasādaparivārebhyo baliṃ dadyādyathākramam | nirgamya saha vāditraistadāśābhimukhaḥ sthitaḥ ||
puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ ca dīpañca dadyādannaṃ jalaiḥ saha | tato dadyānmahāpīṭhe tiṣṭhanbalimudaṅmukhaḥ ||
tato niveditaṃ deve yattadannādikaṃ purā | tatsarvaṃ sāvaśeṣaṃ vā caṇḍāya vinivedayet ||
hutvā ca vidhivatpaścātpūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet | kṛtvā prayogaṃ vidhivadyāvanmantraṃ japaṃ tataḥ ||
nityotsavaṃ prakurvīta yathoktaṃ śivaśāsane | vipule taijase pātre raktapadmopaśobhite ||
astraṃ pāśupataṃ divyaṃ tatrāvāhya samarcayet | śivasyāropyaḥ tatpātraṃ dvijasyālaṃkṛtasya ca ||
nyastāstravapuṣā tena dīptayaṣṭidharasya ca | prāsādaparivārebhyo bahirmaṃgalaniḥsvanaiḥ ||
nṛtyageyādibhiścaiva saha dīpadhvajādibhiḥ | pradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā na drutaṃ cāvilambitam ||
mahāpīṭhaṃ samāvṛtya triḥpradakṣiṇayogataḥ | punaḥ praviṣṭo dvārastho yajamānaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ ||
ādāyābhyaṃtaraṃ nītvā hyastramudvāsayettataḥ | pradakṣiṇādikaṃ kṛtvā yathāpūrvoditaṃ kramāt ||
ādāya cāṣṭapuṣpāṇi pūjāmatha samāpayet ||
upamanyuruvāca | athāgnikāryaṃ vakṣyāmi kuṇḍe vā sthaṃḍile 'pi vā | vedyāṃ vā hyāyase pātre mṛnmaye vā nave śubhe ||
ādhāyāgniṃ vidhānena saṃskṛtya ca tataḥ param | tatrārādhya mahādevaṃ homakarma samācaret ||
kuṇḍaṃ dvihastamānaṃ vā hastamātramathāpi vā | vṛttaṃ vā caturasraṃ vā kuryādvediṃ ca maṇḍalam ||
kuṇḍaṃ vistāravannimnaṃ tanmadhye 'ṣṭadalāmbujam | caturaṃgulamutsedhaṃ tasya dvyaṃgulameva vā ||
vitastidviguṇonnatyā nābhimantaḥ pracakṣate | madhyaṃ ca madhyamāṃgulyā madhyamottamaparvaṇoḥ ||
aṃgulaiḥ kathyate sadbhiścaturviṃśatibhiḥ karaḥ | mekhalānāṃ trayaṃ vāpi dvayamekamathāpi vā ||
yathāśobhaṃ prakurvīta ślakṣṇamiṣṭaṃ mṛdā sthiram | aśvatthapatravadyoniṃ gajādhāravadeva vā ||
mekhalāmadhyataḥ kuryātpaścime dakṣiṇe 'pi vā | śobhanāmagnitaḥ kiṃcinnimnāmunmīlikāṃ śanaiḥ ||
agreṇa kuṇḍābhimukhīṃ kiṃcidutsṛjya mekhalām | notsedhaniyamo vedyāḥ sā mārdī vātha saikatī ||
maṃḍalaṃ gośakṛttoyairmānaṃ pātrasya noditam | kuṇḍaṃ ca mṛnmayaṃ vedimālipedgomayāṃbunā ||
prakṣālya tāpayetpātraṃ prokṣayedanyadaṃbhasā | svasūtroktaprakāreṇa kuṇḍādau villikhettataḥ ||
saṃprokṣya kalpayeddarbhaiḥ puṣpairvā vahniviṣṭaram | arcanārthaṃ ca homārthaṃ sarvadravyāṇi sādhayet ||
prakṣālyakṣālanīyāni prokṣaṇyā prokṣya śodhayet | maṇijaṃ kāṣṭhajaṃ vātha śrotriyāgārasambhavam ||
anyaṃ vābhyarhitaṃ vahniṃ tataḥ sādhāramānayet | triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvṛtya kuṇḍāderupari kramāt ||
vahnibījaṃ samuccārya tvādadhītāgnimāsane | yonimārgeṇa vā tadvadātmanaḥ saṃmukhena vā ||
niyogaḥ pradeśa sarvaṃ kuṃḍaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | svanābhyaṃtaḥsthitaṃ vahniṃ tadraṃdhrādvisphuliṃgavad ||
nirgamya pāvake bāhye līnaṃ biṃbākṛti smaret | ājyasaṃskāraparyaṃtamanvādhānapurassaram ||
svasūtroktakramātkuryānmūlamantreṇa mantravit | śivamūrtiṃ samabhyarcya tato dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ ||
nyasya mantraṃ ghṛte mudrāṃ darśayeddhenusaṃjñitām | sruksruvau taijasau grāhyau na kāṃsyāyasasaisakau ||
yajñadārumayau vāpi smārtau vā śilpasammatau | parṇe vā brahmavṛkṣāderacchidre madhya utthite ||
saṃsṛjya darbhaistau vahnau saṃtāpya prokṣayetpunaḥ | pārārṣarcyasvasūtroktakrameṇa śivapūrvakaiḥ ||
juhuyādaṣṭabhirbījairagnisaṃskārasiddhaye | bhruṃstuṃbruśruṃ krameṇaiva puṃḍraṃdramityataḥ param ||
bījāni sapta saptānāṃ jihvānāmanupūrvaśaḥ | triśikhā madhyamā jihvā bahurūpasamāhvayā ||
raktāgneyī nairṛtī ca kṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matā | atiriktā marujjihvā svanāmānuguṇaprabhā ||
svabījānantaraṃ vācyā svāhāṃtañca yathākramam | jihvāmaṃtraistu tairhutvājyaṃ jihvāstvekaikaśa kramāt ||
raṃ vahnayeti svāheti madhye hutvāhutitrayam | sarpiṣā vā samidbhirvā pariṣecanamācaret ||
evaṃ kṛte śivāgniḥ syātsmarettatra śivāsanam | tatrāvāhya yajeddevamardhanārīśvaraṃ śivam ||
dīpāntaṃ pariṣicyātha samiddhomaṃ samācaret | tāḥ pālāśyaḥ parā vāpi yājñiyā dvādaśāṃgulāḥ ||
avakrā na svayaṃ śuṣkāssatvaco nirvraṇāḥ samāḥ | daśāṃgulā vā vihitāḥ kaniṣṭhāṃgulisaṃmitāḥ ||
prādeśamātrā vālābhe hotavyāḥ sakalā api | dūrvāpatrasamākārāṃ caturaṃgulamāyatām ||
dadyādājyāhutiṃ paścādannamakṣapramāṇataḥ | lājāṃstathā sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃścaiva tilāṃstathā ||
sarpiṣāktāni bhakṣyāṇi lehyacoṣyāṇi sambhave | daśaivāhutayastatra pañca vā tritayaṃ ca vā ||
hotavyāḥ śaktito dadyādekamevātha vāhutim | śruveṇājyaṃ samityādyāsrucāśeṣātkareṇa vā ||
tatra divyena hotavyaṃ tīrthenārṣeṇa vā tathā | dravyeṇaikena vā 'lābhe juhuyācchraddhayā punaḥ ||
prāyaścittāya juhuyānmaṃtrayitvāhutitrayam | tato homaviśiṣṭena ghṛtenāpūrya vai srucam ||
nidhāya puṣpaṃ tasyāgre śruveṇādhomukhena tām | sadarbhena samācchādya mūlenāṃjalinotthitaḥ ||
vauṣaḍaṃtena juhuyāddhārāṃ tu yavasaṃmitām | itthaṃ pūrṇāhutiṃ kṛtvā pariṣiṃcecca pūrvavat ||
tata udvāsya deveśaṃ gopayettu hutāśanam | tamapyudvāsya vā nābhau yajetsaṃdhāya nityaśaḥ ||
athavā vahnimānīya śivaśāstroktavartmanā | vāgīśīgarbhasaṃbhūtaṃ saṃskṛtya vidhivadyajet ||
anvādhānaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā paridhīn paridhāya ca | pātrāṇi dvandvarūpeṇa nikṣipyeṣṭvā śivaṃ tataḥ ||
saṃśodhya prokṣaṇīpātraṃ prokṣyatāni tadaṃbhasā | praṇītāpātramaiśānyāṃ vinyasyā pūritaṃ jalaiḥ ||
ājyasaṃskāraparyaṃtaṃ kṛtvā saṃśodhya sraksruvau | garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tataḥ ||
kṛtvā pṛthakpṛthagghutvā jātamagniṃ vicintayet | tripādaṃ saptahastaṃ ca catuḥśṛṃgaṃ dviśīrṣakam ||
madhupiṃgaṃ trinayanaṃ sakapardenduśekharam | raktaṃ raktāmbarālepaṃ mālyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sopavītaṃ trimekhalam | śaktimantaṃ sruksruvau ca dadhānaṃ dakṣiṇe kare ||
tomaraṃ tālavṛṃtaṃ ca ghṛtapātraṃ tathetaraiḥ | jātaṃ dhyātvaivamākāraṃ jātakarma samācaret ||
nālāpanayanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ saṃśodhya sūtakam | śivāgnirucināmāsya kṛtvāhutipurassaram ||
pitrorvisarjanaṃ kṛtvā caulopanayanādikam | aptoryāmāvasānāntaṃ kṛtvā saṃskāramasya tu ||
ājyadhārādihomaṃ ca kṛtvā sviṣṭakṛtaṃ tataḥ | ramityanena bījena pariṣiṃcettataḥ param ||
brahmaviṣṇuśiveśānāṃ lokeśānāṃ tathaiva ca | tadastrāṇāṃ ca paritaḥ kṛtvā pūjāṃ yathākramam ||
dhūpadīpādisiddhyarthaṃ vahnimuddhṛtya kṛtyavit | sādhayitvājyapūrvāṇi dravyāṇi punareva ca ||
kalpayitvāsanaṃ vahnau tatrāvāhya yathāpurā | saṃpūjya devaṃ devīṃ ca tataḥ pūrṇāṃtamācaret ||
atha vā svāśramoktaṃ tu vahnikarma śivārpaṇam | buddhvā śivāśramī kuryānna ca tatrāparo vidhiḥ ||
śivāgnerbhasmasaṃgrāhyamagnihotrodbhavaṃ tu vā | vaivāhognibhavaṃ vāpi pakvaṃ śuci sugaṃdhi ca ||
kapilāyāḥ śakṛcchastaṃ gṛhītaṃ gagane patat | na klinnaṃ nātikaṭhinaṃ na durgandhaṃ na śoṣitam ||
uparyadhaḥ parityajya gṛhṇīyātpatitaṃ yadi | piṃḍīkṛtya śivāgnyādau tatkṣipenmūlamaṃtrataḥ ||
apakvamatipākvaṃ ca saṃtyajya bhasitaṃ sitam | ādāya vā samāloḍya bhasmādhāre vinikṣipet ||
taijasaṃ dāravaṃ vāpi mṛnmayaṃ śailameva ca | anyadvā śobhanaṃ śuddhaṃ bhasmādhāraṃ prakalpayet ||
same deśe śubhe śuddhe dhanavadbhasma nikṣipet | na cāyuktakare dadyānnaivāśucitale kṣipet ||
na saṃspṛśecca nīcāṃgairnopekṣeta na laṃghayet | tasmādbhasitamādāya viniyuṃjīta mantrataḥ ||
kāleṣūkteṣu nānyatra nāyogyebhyaḥ pradāpayet | bhasmasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāddeve 'nudvāsite sati ||
udvāsane kṛte yasmāccaṇḍabhasma prajāpate | agnikārye kṛte paścācchivaśāstroktamārgataḥ ||
svasūtroktaprakārādvā balikarma samācaret | atha vidyāsanaṃ nyasya supralipte tu maṇḍale ||
vidyākośaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yajetpuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt | vidyāyāḥ purataḥ kṛtvā gurorapi ca maṇḍalam ||
tatrāsanavaraṃ kṛtvā puṣpādyai gurumarcayet | tatonupūjayetpūjyān bhojayecca bubhukṣitān ||
tatassvayaṃ ca bhuṃjīta śuddhamannaṃ yathāsukham | niveditaṃ ca vā deve taccheṣaṃ cātmaśuddhaye ||
śraddadhāno na lobhena na caṇḍāya samarpitam | gandhamālyādi yaccānyattatrāpyeṣa samo vidhiḥ ||
na tu tatra śivosmīti buddhiṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ | bhuktvācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā hṛdaye mūlamuccaret ||
kālaśeṣaṃ nayedyogyaiḥ śivaśāstrakathādibhiḥ | rātrau vyatīte pūrvāṃśe kṛtvā pūjāṃ manoharām ||
śivayoḥ śayanaṃ tvekaṃ kalpayedatiśobhanam | bhakṣyabhojyāṃbarālepapuṣpamālādikaṃ tathā ||
manasā karmaṇā vāpi kṛtvā sarvaṃ manoharam | tato devasya devyāśca pādamūle śucissvapet ||
gṛhastho bhāryayā sārdhaṃ tadanye 'pi tu kevalāḥ | pratyūṣasamayaṃ buddhvā mātrāmādyāmudīrayet ||
praṇamya manasāṃ devaṃ sāṃbaṃ sagaṇamavyayam | deśakālocitaṃ kṛtvā śaucādyamapi śaktitaḥ ||
śaṃkhādininadairdivyairdevaṃ devīṃ ca bodhayet | tatastatsamayonnidraiḥ puṣpairatisugaṃdhibhiḥ ||
nirvartya śivayoḥ pūjāṃ prārabheta puroditam ||
upamanyuruvāca | ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śivāśramaniṣeviṇām | śivaśāstroktamārgeṇa naimittikavidhikramam ||
sarveṣvapi ca māseṣu pakṣayorubhayorapi | aṣṭābhyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ tathā parvāṇi ca kramāt ||
ayane viṣuve caiva grahaṇeṣu viśeṣataḥ | kartavyā mahatī pūjā hyadhikā vāpi śaktitaḥ ||
māsimāsi yathānyāyaṃ brahmakūrcaṃ prasādhya tu | snāpayitvā śivaṃ tena pibeccheṣamupoṣitaḥ ||
brahmahatyādidoṣāṇāmatīva mahatāmapi | niṣkṛtirbrahmakūrcasya pānānnānyā viśiṣyate ||
pauṣe puṣyanakṣatre kuryānnīrājanaṃ vibhoḥ | māghe maghākhye nakṣatre pradadyādghṛtakaṃbalam ||
phālgune cottarānte vai prārabheta mahotsavam | caitre citrāpaurṇamāsyāṃ dolāṃ kuryādyathāvidhi ||
vaiśākhyāṃ tu viśākhāyāṃ kuryātpuṣpamahālayam | jyeṣṭhe mūlākhyanakṣatre śītakumbhaṃ pradāpayet ||
āṣāḍhe cottarāṣāḍhe pavitrāropaṇaṃ tathā | śrāvaṇe prākṛtānyāpi maṇḍalāni prakalpayet ||
śraviṣṭhākhye tu nakṣatre prauṣṭhapadyāṃ tataḥ param | prokṣayecca jalakrīḍāṃ pūrvāṣāḍhāśraye dine ||
āśvayujyāṃ tato dadyātpāyasaṃ ca navodanam | agnikāryaṃ ca tenaiva kuryācchatabhiṣagdine ||
kārtikyāṃ kṛtikāyoge dadyāddīpasahasrakam | mārgaśīrṣe tathārdrāyāṃ ghṛtena snāpayecchivam ||
aśaktasteṣu kāleṣu kuryādutsavameva vā | āsthānaṃ vā mahāpūjāmadhikaṃ vā samarcanam ||
āvṛtte 'pi ca kalyāṇe praśasteṣvapi karmasu | daurmanasye durācāre duḥsvapne duṣṭadarśane ||
utpāte vāśubhenyasminroge vā prabale 'tha vā | snānapūjājapadhyānahomadānādikāḥ kriyaḥ ||
nirmitānuguṇāḥ kāryāḥ puraścaraṇapūrvikāḥ | śivānale ca vihate punassandhānamācaret ||
ya evaṃ śarvadharmiṣṭho vartate nityamudyataḥ | tasyaikajanmanā muktiṃ prayacchati maheśvaraḥ ||
etadyathottaraṃ kuryānnityanaimittikeṣu yaḥ | divyaṃ śrīkaṃṭhanāthasya sthānamādyaṃ sa gacchati ||
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānkalpakoṭiśatannaraḥ | kālāṃtarecyutastasmādaumaṃ kaumārameva ca ||
saṃprāpya vaiṣṇavaṃ brāhmaṃ rudralokaṃ viśeṣataḥ | tatroṣitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ bhuktvā bhogānyathoditān ||
punaścordhvaṃ gatastasmādatītya sthānapañcakam | śrīkaṇṭhājjñānamāsādya tasmācchaivapuraṃ vrajet ||
ardhacaryārataścāpi dvirāvṛttyaivameva tu | paścājjñānaṃ samāsādya śivasāyujyamāpnuyāt ||
ardhārdhacarito yastu dehī dehakṣayātparam | aṃḍāṃtaṃ vordhvamavyaktamatītya bhuvanadvayam ||
saṃprāpya pauruṣaṃ raudrasthānamadrīndrajāpateḥ | anekayugasāhasraṃ bhuktvā bhogānanekadhā ||
puṇyakṣaye kṣitiṃ prāpya kule mahati jāyate | tatrāpi pūrvasaṃskāravaśena sa mahādyutiḥ ||
paśudharmānparityajya śivadharmarato bhavet | taddharmagauravādeva dhyātvā śivapuraṃ vrajet ||
bhogāṃśca vividhānbhuktvā vidyeśvarapadaṃ vrajet | tatra vidyeśvaraissārdhaṃ bhuktvā bhogānbahūnkramāt ||
aṇḍasyāṃtarbahirvātha sakṛdāvartate punaḥ | tato labdhvā śivajñānaṃ parāṃ bhaktimavāpya ca ||
śivasādharmyamāsādya na bhūyo vinivartate | yaścātīva śive bhakto viṣayāsaktacittavat ||
śivadarmānaso kurvannakurvanvāpi mucyate | ekāvṛtto dvirāvṛttastrirāvṛtto nivartakaḥ ||
na punaścakravartī syācchivadharmādhikāravān | tasmāccchivāśrito bhūtvā yena kenāpi hetunā ||
śivadharme matiṃ kuryācchreyase cetkṛtodyamaḥ | nātra nirbaṃdhayiṣyāmo vayaṃ kecana kenacit ||
nirbandhebhyo 'tivādebhyaḥ prakṛtyaitanna rocate | rocate vā parebhyastu puṇyasaṃskāragauravāt ||
saṃsārakāraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ na praroḍhumalaṃ bhavet | prakṛtyanuguṇaṃ tasmādvimṛśyaitadaśeṣataḥ ||
śivadharme 'dhikurvīta yadīcchecchivamātmanaḥ ||
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | bhagavaṃstvanmukhādeva śrutaṃ śrutisamaṃ mayā | svāśritānāṃ śivaproktaṃ nityanaimittikaṃ tathā ||
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi śivadharmādhikāriṇām | kāmyamapyasti cetkarma vaktumarhasi sāmpratam ||
upamanyuruvāca | astyaihikaphalaṃ kiñcidāmuṣmikaphalaṃ tathā | aihikāmuṣmikañcāpi tacca pañcavidhaṃ punaḥ ||
kiṃcitkriyāmayaṃ karma kiṃcitkarma tapo mayam | japadhyānamayaṃ kiṃcitkiṃcitsarvamayaṃ tathā ||
kriyāmayaṃ tathā bhinnaṃ homadānārcanakramāt | sarvaśaktimatāmeva nānyeṣāṃ saphalaṃ bhavet ||
śaktiścājñā madeśasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ | tasmātkāmyāni karmāṇi kuryādājñādharodvijaḥ ||
atha vakṣyāmi kāmyaṃ hi cehāmutra phalapradam | śaivairmāheśvaraiścaiva kāryamaṃtarbahiḥ kramāt ||
śivo maheśvaraśceti nātyaṃtamiha bhidyate | yathā tathā na bhidyaṃte śaivā māheśvarā api ||
śivāśritā hi te śaivā jñānayajñaratā narāḥ | māheśvarāssamākhyātā karmayajñaratā bhuvi ||
tasmādābhyantare kuryuḥ śaivā māheśvarā vahiḥ | na tu prayogo bhidyeta vakṣyamāṇasya karmaṇaḥ ||
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ vidhivadgaṃdhavarṇarasādibhiḥ | manobhilaṣite tatra vitānavitatāṃbare ||
supralipte mahīpṛṣṭhe darpaṇodarasaṃnibhe | prācīmutpādayetpūrvaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā ||
ekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā maṇḍalaṃ parikalpayet | ālikhedvimalaṃ padmamaṣṭapatraṃ sakarṇikam ||
ratnahemādibhiścūrṇairyathāsaṃbhavasaṃbhṛtaiḥ | pañcāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ bahuśobhāsamanvitam ||
daleṣu siddhayaḥ kalpyāḥ kesareṣu saśaktikāḥ | rudrā vāmādayastvaṣṭau pūrvādidalataḥ kramāt ||
karṇikāyāṃ ca vairāgyaṃ bījeṣu nava śaktayaḥ | skande śivātmako dharmo nāle jñānaṃ śivāśrayam ||
karṇikopari cāgneyaṃ maṃḍalaṃ sauramaindavam | śivavidyātmatattvākhyaṃ tattvatrayamataḥ param ||
sarvāsanopari sukhaṃ vicitrakusumānvitam | pañcāvaraṇasaṃyuktaṃ pūjayedaṃbayā saha ||
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ prasannaṃ śītaladyutim | vidyudvalayasaṃkāśajaṭāmukuṭabhūṣitam ||
śārdūlacarmavasanaṃ kiñcitsmitamukhāṃbujam | raktapadmadalaprakhyapādapāṇitalādharam ||
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam | divyāyudhavarairyuktaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanam ||
pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ candrakhaṇḍaśikhāmaṇim | asya pūrvamukhaṃ saumyaṃ bālārkasadṛśaprabham ||
trilocanāraviṃdāḍhyaṃ kṛtabāleṃduśekharam | dakṣiṇaṃ nīlajīmūtasamānaruciraprabham ||
bhrukuṭīkuṭilaṃ ghoraṃ raktavṛttekṣaṇatrayam | daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ durdharṣaṃ sphuritādharapallavam ||
uttaraṃ vidrumaprakhyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam | savilāsaṃ trinayanaṃ candrābharaṇaśekharam ||
paścimaṃ pūrṇacandrābhaṃ locanatritayojjvalam | candrarekhādharaṃ saumyaṃ maṃdasmitamanoharam ||
pañcamaṃ sphaṭikaprakhyamiṃdurekhāsamujjvalam | atīva saumyamutphullalocanatritayojjvalam ||
dakṣiṇe śūlaparaśuvajrakhaḍgānalojjvalam | savye ca nāganārācaghaṇṭāpāśāṃkuśojjvalam ||
nivṛttyājānusaṃbaddhamānābheśca pratiṣṭhayā | ākaṃṭhaṃ vidyayā tadvadālalāṭaṃ tu śāṃtayā ||
tadūrdhvaṃ śāṃtyatītākhyakalayā parayā tathā | pañcādhvavyāpinaṃ sākṣātkalāpañcakavigraham ||
īśānamukuṭaṃ devaṃ puruṣākhyaṃ purātanam | aghorahṛdayaṃ tadvadvāmaguhyaṃ maheśvaram ||
sadyapādaṃ ca tanmūrtimaṣṭatriṃśatkalāmayam | mātṛkāmayamīśānaṃ pañcabrahmamayaṃ tathā ||
oṃkārākhyamayaṃ caiva haṃsaśaktyā samanvitam | tathecchātmikayā śaktyā samārūḍhāṃkamaṃḍalam ||
jñānākhyayā dakṣiṇato vāmataśca kriyākhyayā | tattvatrayamayaṃ sākṣādvidyāmūrtiṃ sadāśivam ||
mūrtimūlena saṃkalpya sakalīkṛtya ca kramāt | saṃpūjya ca yathānyāyamarghāntaṃ mūlavidyayā ||
mūrtimantaṃ śivaṃ sākṣācchaktyā paramayā saha | tatrāvāhya mahādevaṃ sadasadvyaktivarjitam ||
pañcopakaraṇaṃ kṛtvā pūjayetparameśvaram | brahmabhiśca ṣaḍaṅgaiśca tato mātṛkayā saha ||
praṇavena śivenaiva śaktiyuktena ca kramāt | śāṃtena vā tathānyaiśca vedamantraiśca kṛtsnaśaḥ ||
pūjayetparamaṃ devaṃ kevalena śivena vā | pādyādimukhavāsāṃtaṃ kṛtvā prasthāpanaṃ vinā ||
pañcāvaraṇapūjāṃ tu hyārabheta yathākramam ||
tatrādau śivayoḥ pārśve dakṣiṇe vāmataḥ kramāt | gaṃdhādyairarcayetpūrvaṃ devau heraṃbaṣaṇmukhau ||
tato brahmāṇi parita īśānādi yathākramam | saśaktikāni sadyāṃtaṃ prathamāvaraṇe yajet ||
ṣaḍaṃgānyapi tatraiva hṛdayādīnyanukramāt | śivasya ca śivāyāśca vāhneyādi samarcayet ||
tatra vāmādikānrudrānaṣṭau vāmādiśaktibhiḥ | arcayedvā na vā paścātpūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt ||
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ mayā te yadunaṃdana | dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ prītyā procyate śraddhayā śṛṇu ||
anaṃtaṃ pūrvādikpatre tacchaktiṃ tasya vāmataḥ | sūkṣmaṃ dakṣiṇadikpatre saha śaktyā samarcayet ||
tataḥ paścimadikpatre saha śaktyā śivottamam | tathaivottaradikpatre caikanetraṃ samarcayet ||
ekarudraṃ ca tacchaktiṃ paścādīśadale 'rcayet | trimūrtiṃ tasya śaktiṃ ca pūjayedagnidigdale ||
śrīkaṇṭhaṃ nairṛte patre tacchaktiṃ tasya vāmataḥ | tathaiva mārute patre śikhaṃḍīśaṃ samarcayet ||
dvitīyāvaraṇe cejyāssarvartaścakravartinaḥ | tṛtīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ śaktibhiścāṣṭamūrtayaḥ ||
aṣṭasu kramaśo dikṣu pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt | bhavaḥ śarvastatheśāno rudraḥ paśupatistataḥ ||
ugro bhīmo mahādeva ityaṣṭau mūrtayaḥ kramāt | anaṃtaraṃ tataścaiva mahādevādayaḥ kramāt ||
śaktibhissaha saṃpūjyāstatraikādaśamūrtayaḥ | mahādevaḥ śivo rudraḥ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ ||
īśāno vijayo bhīmo devadevo bhavodbhavaḥ | kapardīśaśca kathyaṃte tathaikādaśaśaktayaḥ ||
tatrāṣṭau prathamaṃ pūjyāḥ vāhneyādi yathākramam | devadevaḥ pūrvapatre īśānaṃ cāgnigocare ||
bhavodbhavastayormadhye kapālīśastataḥ param | tasminnāvaraṇe bhūyo vṛṣendraṃ purato yajet ||
naṃdinaṃ dakṣiṇe tasya mahākālaṃ tathottare | śāstāraṃ vahnidikpatre mātḥrdakṣiṇadigdale ||
gajāsyaṃ nairṛte patre ṣaṇmukhaṃ vāruṇe punaḥ | jyeṣṭhāṃ vāyudale gaurīmuttare caṃḍamaiśvare ||
śāstṛnandīśayormadhye munīndraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ yajet | mahākālasyottarataḥ piṃgalaṃ tu samarcayet ||
śāstṛmātṛsamūhasya madhye bhṛṃgīśvaraṃ tataḥ | mātṛvighneśamadhye tu vīrabhadraṃ samarcayet ||
skandavighneśayormadhye yajeddevīṃ sarasvatīm | jyeṣṭhākumārayormadhye śriyaṃ śivapadārcitām ||
jyeṣṭhāgaṇāmbayormadhye mahāmoṭīṃ samarcayet | gaṇāmbācaṇḍayormadhye devīṃ durgāṃ prapūjayet ||
atraivāvaraṇe bhūyaḥ śivānucarasaṃhatim | rudraprathamabhūtākhyāṃ vividhāṃ ca saśaktikām ||
śivāyāśca sakhīvargaṃ japeddhyātvā samāhitaḥ | evaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇe vitate pūjite sati ||
caturthāvaraṇaṃ dhyātvā bahistasya samarcayet | bhānuḥ pūrvadale pūjyo dakṣiṇe caturānanaḥ ||
rudro varuṇadikpatre viṣṇuruttaradigdale | caturṇāmapi devānāṃ pṛthagāvaraṇānyatha ||
tasyāṃgāni ṣaḍevādau dīptādyābhiśca śaktibhiḥ | dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā kramāt ||
amoghā vidyutā caiva pūrvādi paritaḥ sthitāḥ | dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāścatasro mūrtayaḥ kramāt ||
pūrvādyuttaraparyaṃtāḥ śaktayaśca tataḥ param | ādityo bhāskaro bhānū raviścetyanupūrvaśaḥ ||
arko brahmā tathā rudro viṣṇuścaite vivasvataḥ | vistārā pūrvadigbhāge sutarāṃ dakṣiṇe sthitāḥ ||
bodhanī paścime bhāge āpyāyinyuttare punaḥ | uṣāṃ prabhāṃ tathā prājñāṃ sandhyāmapi tataḥ param ||
aiśānādiṣu vinyasya dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet | somamaṃgārakaṃ caiva budhaṃ buddhimatāṃ varam ||
bṛhaspatiṃ bṛhadbuddhiṃ bhārgavaṃ tejasāṃ nidhim | śanaiścaraṃ tathā rāhuṃ ketuṃ dhūmraṃ bhayaṃkaram ||
samaṃtato yajedetāṃstṛtīyāvaraṇe kramāt | athavā dvādaśādityā dvitīyāvaraṇe yajet ||
tṛtīyāvaraṇe caiva rāśīndvādaśa pūjayet | saptasapta gaṇāṃścaiva bahistasya samaṃtataḥ ||
ṛṣīndevāṃśca gaṃdharvānpannagānapsarogaṇān | grāmaṇyaśca tathā yakṣānyātudhānāṃstathā hayān ||
saptacchaṃdomayāṃścaiva vālakhilyāṃśca pūjayet | evaṃ tṛtīyāvaraṇe samabhyarcya divākaram ||
brahmāṇamarcayetpaścāttribhirāvaraṇaiḥ sahaḥ | hiraṇyagarbhaṃ pūrvasyāṃ virājaṃ dakṣiṇe tataḥ ||
kālaṃ paścimadigbhāge puruṣaṃ cottare yajet | hiraṇyagarbhaḥ prathamo brahmā kamalasannibhaḥ ||
kālo jātyaṃjanaprakhyaḥ puruṣaḥ sphaṭikopamaḥ | triguṇo rājasaścaiva tāmasaḥ sāttvikastathā ||
catvāra ete kramaśaḥ prathamāvaraṇe sthitāḥ | dvitīyāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ pūrvādiparitaḥ kramāt ||
sanatkumāraḥ sanakaḥ sanaṃdaśca sanātanaḥ | tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścādarcayecca prajāpatīn ||
aṣṭau pūrvāṃśca pūrvādau trīnprākpaścādanukramāt | dakṣo rucirbhṛguścaiva marīciśca tathāṃgirāḥ ||
pulastyaḥ pulahaścaiva kraturatriśca kaśyapaḥ | vasiṣṭhaśceti vikhyātāḥ prajānāṃ patayastvime ||
teṣāṃ bhāryāśca taissārdhaṃ pūjanīyā yathākramam | prasūtiśca tathākūtiḥ khyātiḥ sambhūtireva ca ||
dhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ kṣamā caiva sannatiścānasūyakā | devamātārundhatī ca sarvāḥ khalu pativratāḥ ||
śivārcanarato nityaṃ śrīmatyaḥ priyadarśanāḥ | prathamāvaraṇe vedāṃścaturo vā prapūjayet ||
itihāsapurāṇāni dvitīyāvaraṇe punaḥ | tṛtīyāvaraṇe paścāddharmaśāstrapurassarāḥ ||
vaidikyo nikhilā vidyāḥ pūjyā eva samaṃtataḥ | pūrvādipurato vedāstadanye tu yathāruci ||
aṣṭadhā vā caturdhā vā kṛtvā pūjāṃ samaṃtataḥ | evaṃ brahmāṇamabhyarcya tribhirāvaraṇairyutam ||
dakṣiṇe paścime paścādrudraṃ sāvaraṇaṃ yajet | tasya brahmaṣaḍaṃgāni prathamāvaraṇaṃ smṛtam ||
dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva vidyeśvaramayaṃ tathā | tṛtīyāvaraṇe bhedo vidyate sa tu kathyate ||
catasro mūrtayastasya pūjyāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramāt | triguṇāssakalo devaḥ purastācchivasaṃjñakaḥ ||
rājaso dakṣiṇe brahmā sṛṣṭikṛtpūjyate bhavaḥ | tāmasaḥ paścime cāgniḥ pūjyassaṃhārako haraḥ ||
sāttvikassukhakṛtsaumye viṣṇurviśvapatirmṛḍaḥ | evaṃ paścimadigbhāge śambhoḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaṃ śivam ||
samabhyarcyottare pārśve tato vaikuṃṭhamarcayet | vāsudevaṃ puraskṛtvā prathamāvaraṇe yajet ||
aniruddhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ pradyumnaṃ paścime tataḥ | saumye saṃkarṣaṇaṃ paścādvyatyastau vā yajedimau ||
prathamāvaraṇaṃ proktaṃ dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śubham | matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃhotha vāmanaḥ ||
rāmaścānyatamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavānaśvamukhopi ca | tṛtīyāvaraṇe cakruḥ pūrvabhāge samarcayet ||
nārāyaṇākhyāṃ yāmyestraṃ kvacidavyāhataṃ yajet | paścime pāṃcajanyaṃ ca śārṅgaṃdhanurathottare ||
evaṃ tryāvaraṇaiḥ sākṣādviśvākhyāṃ paramaṃ harim | mahāviṣṇuṃ sadāviṣṇuṃ mūrtīkṛtya samarcayet ||
itthaṃ viṣṇoścaturvyūhakramānmūrticatuṣṭayam | pūjayitvā ca tacchaktīścatasraḥ pujayetkramāt ||
prabhāmāgneyadigbhāge nairṛte tu sarasvatīm | gaṇāṃbikā ca vāyavye lakṣmīṃ raudre samarcayet ||
evaṃ bhānvādimūrtīnāṃ tacchaktīnāmanaṃtaram | pūjāṃ vidhāya lokeśāṃstatraivāvaraṇe yajet ||
indramagniṃ yamaṃ caiva nirṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ tathā | vāyuṃ somaṃ kuberaṃ ca paścādīśānamarcayet ||
evaṃ caturthāvaraṇaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ | āyudhāni maheśasya paścādbāṃhyaṃ samarcayet ||
śrīmantriśūlamaiśāne vajraṃ māhendradiṅmukhe | paraśuṃ vahnidigbhāge yāmye sāyakamarcayet ||
nairṛte tu yajetkhaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ vāruṇagocare | aṃkuśaṃ mārute bhāge pinākaṃ cottare yajet ||
paścimābhimukhaṃ raudraṃ kṣetrapālaṃ samarcayet | pañcamāvaraṇaṃ caiva sampūjyānantaraṃ bahiḥ ||
sarvāvaraṇadevānāṃ bahirvā pañcame 'thavā | pañcame mātṛbhissārdhaṃ mahokṣa purato yajet ||
tataḥ samaṃtataḥ pūjyāssarvā vai devayonayaḥ | khecarā ṛṣayassiddhā daityā yakṣāśca rākṣasāḥ ||
anaṃtādyāśca nāgeṃdrā nāgaistattatkulodbhavaiḥ | ḍākinībhūtavetālapretabhairavanāyakāḥ ||
pātālavāsinaścānye nānāyonisamudbhavāḥ | nadyassamudrā girayaḥ kānanāni sarāṃsi ca ||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo vṛkṣāḥ kīṭādyāḥ kṣudrayonayaḥ | narāśca vividhākārā mṛgāśca kṣudrayonayaḥ ||
bhuvanānyantaraṇḍasya tato brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ | bahiraṃḍānyasaṃkhyāni bhuvanāni sahādhipaiḥ ||
brahmāṃḍādhārakā rudrā daśadikṣu vyavasthitāḥ | yadgauḍa yacca māmeyaṃ yadvā śāktaṃ tataḥ param ||
yatkiñcidasti śabdasya vācyaṃ cidacidātmakam | tatsarvaṃ śivayoḥ pārśve buddhvā sāmānyato yajet ||
kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sarve 'ciṃtyāḥ smitamukhāstathā | prītyā saṃprekṣamāṇāśca devaṃ devīṃ ca sarvadā ||
itthamāvaraṇābhyarcāṃ kṛtvāvikṣepaśāṃtaye | punarabhyarcya deveśaṃ paktvākṣaramudīrayet ||
nivedayettataḥ paścācchivayoramṛtopamam | suvyañjanasamāyuktaṃ śuddhaṃ cāru mahācarum ||
dvātriṃśadāḍhakairmukhyamadhamaṃ tvāḍhakāvaram | sādhayitvā yathāsaṃpacchraddhayā vinivedayet ||
tato nivedya pānīyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ copadaṃśakaiḥ | nīrājanādikaṃ kṛtvā pūjāśeṣaṃ samāpayet ||
bhogopayogyadravyāṇi viśiṣṭānyeva sādhayet | vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta bhaktimānvibhave sati ||
śaṭhasyopekṣakasyāpi vyaṃgyaṃ caivānutiṣṭhataḥ | na phalaṃtyeva karmāṇi kāmyānīti satāṃ kathā ||
tasmātsamyagupekṣāṃ ca tyaktvā sarvāṃgayogataḥ | kuryātkāmyāni karmāṇi phalasiddhiṃ yadīcchati ||
itthaṃ pūjāṃ samāpyātha devaṃ devīṃ praṇamya ca | bhaktyā manassamādhāya paścātstotramudīrayet ||
tataḥ stotramupāsyānte tvaṣṭottaraśatāvarām | japetpañcākṣarīṃ vidyāṃ sahasrottaramutsukaḥ ||
vidyāpūjāṃ guroḥ pūjāṃ kṛtvā paścādyathākramam | yathodayaṃ yathāśrāddhaṃ sadasyānapi pūjayet ||
tataḥ udvāsya deveśaṃ sarvairāvaraṇaiḥ saha | maṇḍalaṃ gurave dadyādyāgopakaraṇaissaha ||
śivāśritebhyo vā dadyātsarvamevānupūrvaśaḥ | athavā tacchivāyaiva śivakṣetre samarpayet ||
śivāgnau vā yajeddevaṃ homadravyaiśca saptabhiḥ | samabhyarcya yathānyāyaṃ sarvāvaraṇadevatāḥ ||
eṣa yogeśvaro nāma triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ | na tasmādadhikaḥ kaścidyāgo 'sti bhuvane kvacit ||
na tadasti jagatyasminnasadhyaṃ yadanena tu | aihikaṃ vā phalaṃ kiṃcidāmuṣmikaphalaṃ tu vā ||
idamasya phalaṃ nedamiti naiva niyamyate | śreyorūpasya kṛtsnasya tadidaṃ śreṣṭasādhanam ||
idaṃ na śakyate vaktuṃ puruṣeṇa yadarcyate | ciṃtāmaṇerivaitasmāttattena prāpyate phalam ||
tathāpi kṣudramuddiśya phalaṃ naitatprayojayet | laghvarthī mahato yasmātsvayaṃ laghutaro bhavet ||
mahadvā phalamalpaṃ vā kṛtaṃ cetkarma sidhyati | mahādevaṃ samuddiśya kṛtaṃ karma prayujyatām ||
tasmādananyalabhyeṣu śatrumṛtyuṃjayādiṣu | phaleṣu dṛṣṭādṛṣṭeṣu kuryādetadvicakṣaṇaḥ ||
mahatsvapi ca pāteṣu mahārāgabhayādiṣu | durbhikṣādiṣu śāṃtyarthaṃ śāṃtiṃ kuryādanena tu ||
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena mahāvyāpannivārakam | ātmīyamastraṃ śaivānāmidamāha maheśvaraḥ ||
tasmāditaḥ paraṃ nāsti paritrāṇamihātmanaḥ | iti matvā prayuṃjānaḥ karmedaṃ śubhamaśnute ||
stotramātraṃ śucirbhūtvā yaḥ paṭhetsusamāhitaḥ | sopyabhīṣṭatamādarthādaṣṭāṃśaphalamāpnuyāt ||
arthaṃ tasyānusandhāya parvaṇyanaśanaḥ paṭhet | aṣṭābhyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ phalamardhaṃ samāpnuyāt ||
yastvarthamanusaṃdhāya parvādiṣu tathā vratī | māsamekaṃ japetstotraṃ sa kṛtsnaṃ phalamāpnuyāt ||
upamanyuruvāca | stotraṃ vakṣyāmi te kṛṣṇa pañcāvaraṇamārgataḥ | yogeśvaramidaṃ puṇyaṃ karma yena samāpyate ||
jaya jaya jagadekanātha śaṃbho prakṛtimanohara nityacitsvabhāva | atigatakaluṣaprapañcavācāmapi manasāṃ padavīmatītatattvam ||
svabhāvanirmalābhoga jaya sundaraceṣṭita | svātmatulyamahāśakte jaya śuddhaguṇārṇava ||
anantakāṃtisaṃpanna jayāsadṛśavigraha | atarkyamahimādhāra jayānākulamaṃgala ||
niraṃjana nirādhāra jaya niṣkāraṇodaya | nirantaraparānanda jaya nirvṛtikāraṇa ||
jayātiparamaiśvarya jayātikaruṇāspada | jaya svataṃtrasarvasva jayāsadṛśavaibhava ||
jayāvṛtamahāviśva jayānāvṛta kenacit | jayottara samastasya jayātyantaniruttara ||
jayādbhuta jayākṣudra jayākṣata jayāvyaya | jayāmeya jayāmāya jayābhāva jayāmala ||
mahābhuja mahāsāra mahāguṇa mahākatha | mahābala mahāmāya mahārasa mahāratha ||
namaḥ paramadevāya namaḥ paramahetave | namaśśivāya śāṃtāya namaśśivatarāya te ||
tvadadhīnamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ jagaddhi sasurāsuram | atastvadvihitāmājñāṃ kṣamate ko 'tivartitum ||
ayaṃ punarjano nityaṃ bhavadekasamāśrayaḥ | bhavānato 'nugṛhyāsmai prārthitaṃ saṃprayacchatu ||
jayāṃbike jaganmātarjaya sarvajaganmayi | jayānavadhikaiśvarye jayānupamavigrahe ||
jaya vāṅmanasātīte jayāciddhvāṃtabhaṃjike | jaya janmajarāhīne jaya kālottarottare ||
jayānekavidhānasthe jaya viśveśvarapriye | jaya viśvasurārādhye jaya viśvavijṛṃbhiṇi ||
jaya maṃgaladivyāṃgi jaya maṃgaladīpike | jaya maṃgalacāritre jaya maṃgaladāyini ||
namaḥ paramakalyāṇaguṇasaṃcayamūrtaye | tvattaḥ khalu samutpannaṃ jagattvayyeva līyate ||
tvadvinātaḥ phalaṃ dātumīśvaropi na śaknuyāt | janmaprabhṛti deveśi janoyaṃ tvadupāśritaḥ ||
ato 'sya tava bhaktasya nirvartaya manoratham | pañcavaktro daśabhujaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ ||
varṇabrahmakalādeho devassakalaniṣkalaḥ | śivabhaktisamārūḍhaḥ śāṃtyatītassadāśivaḥ ||
bhaktyā mayārcito mahyaṃ prārthitaṃ śaṃ prayacchatu | sadāśivāṃkamārūḍhā śaktiricchā śivāhvayā ||
jananī sarvalokānāṃ prayacchatu manoratham | śivayordayitā putrau devau heraṃbaṣaṇmukhau ||
śivānubhāvau sarvajñau śivajñānāmṛtāśinau | tṛptau parasparaṃ snigdhau śivābhyāṃ nityasatkṛtau ||
satkṛtau ca sadā devau brahmādyaistridaśairapi | sarvalokaparitrāṇaṃ kartumabhyuditau sadā ||
svecchāvatāraṃ kurvaṃtau svāṃśabhedairanekaśaḥ | tāvimau śivayoḥ pārśve nityamitthaṃ mayārcitau ||
tayorājñāṃ puraskṛtya prārthitaṃ me prayacchatām | śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśamīśānākhyaṃ sadāśivam ||
mūrdhābhimāninī mūrtiḥ śivasya paramātmanaḥ | śivārcanarataṃ śāṃtaṃ śāṃtyatītaṃ makhāsthitam ||
pañcākṣarāṃtimaṃ bījaṃ kalābhiḥ pañcabhiryutam | prathamāvaraṇe pūrvaṃ śaktyā saha samarcitam ||
